subject: Take it from me, Adam’s older brother, he’s the real deal
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4898%2E5257348%2ElrMlm4 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

Well, you’ve heard from Boca Eddie (Dad), and now it’s older brother Dan
chiming in with a tale as improbable as it is true from our shared history
as kids...

People often come up to me and ask — what’s Adam like? I mean, not on TV,
or the news, but what’s he really like? I am here to give you the real
scoop.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/3416?c0=dec2023_abs_em.v9lHlW&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20231228_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=5&t=1004&akid=4898%2E5257348%2ElrMlm4 ]If I don’t have to convince you and you’re already sold, please chip in
$5 to
Adam’s critical end-of-year deadline right now. If not, I hope you’ll read
on about why Adam’s older brother is supporting him for U.S. Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20231228_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=4898%2E5257348%2ElrMlm4 ]Throwback photo of Adam and his older brother, Dan, as boy scouts

As boys, we lived on a lively street in Framingham, Massachusetts with
tons of kids. One boy who lived next door had unique skills. He could draw
in his breath, gulp it in deep, and then let loose with “burp” speech
sentences long and with such range he could do song lyrics.

One day after school, the bus dropped off Adam and me at the usual stop.
Typically we’d horse around and kill time for the two-mile walk home.
(Okay maybe only one mile, but uphill in both directions.)

Only this time, Adam, age 7, decided he’d practice his burp-speak and
maybe unseat the champ on our block. After fits and starts, and much
ardent croaking, he succeeded only in being annoying as hell. So, to make
him stop, I flung my jacket at him, and the zipper chipped a front tooth.
He bled. And howled all the way home.

I told Adam to get creative and say he had bumped into a tree, or tripped
over a log, or stumbled off the bus steps. Really anything. I gave him so
many choices! But he howled even louder with each suggestion.

When at last we got home, and Mom opened the door to see Adam’s bloody
face and chipped tooth, I told her I was fine, but Adam walked into a
tree, etc... it was THEN that Adam calmly and clearly went through a catalog
of each of my lies, calling out each ruse, one by one, with perfect cool
and not a howl to be heard.

Adam could not and would not be bullied — not even at age 7!

Neither did he demand retribution from our parents, or prevaricate about
what really happened. When I look back I see that my brother’s sense of
truth and justice (and mercy) had as their inspiration this practice
period of our youth, and that is why I am asking you to help me help him
to continue to speak out and stand up against the real bullies of our era.

Adam has the decency and calm since his earliest days to stand up, assert
himself, and not be cowed. Though this is a true story from our youth, I’m
proud of how my brother, even as a kid, couldn’t be persuaded to go along
with baloney... or be conned into doing something unjust... it’s not in his
nature.

And it’s why I wasn’t surprised when Adam was able to stand up against
Donald Trump, his MAGA supporters in the House and Senate, and for our
shared values of truth and decency... no matter what was thrown his way.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=dec2023_abs_em.8jAHEM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20231228_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=5&t=1006&akid=4898%2E5257348%2ElrMlm4 ]So that’s why I’m asking you to donate
$5 to his
campaign today. His race for the U.S. Senate is neck and neck, and with
his campaign buying television advertisements next month, they need your
support now more than ever.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

sentence!

Dan Schiff

name: American Defense News
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9k18hu39pohi6prkfs5ke5r2f4sfgufgmm2q0bg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor2cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0siq2b2rsdtb3h9n1cmo74do9f251aa4qlnbceo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor2cjh2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjjc4h661tj17ncrao0pan7te4fub00asdnjeb90_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor2cjh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2krpkgmmldo86h2lpqvoq1o60078mjeukr7hiao_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor2cjh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

body:

It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl5csku8j3legnasootrfk66m43nrcu4u23f3pbo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor1c9h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

name: ICYMI News
subject: Who controls whom?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| | | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp4g9hmt47fts61b6too300g68n2sk9jg6t3ca68_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor5c9h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2ekr17argmuptlblii61o79d372d407to6gthpg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor5c9h2bs)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdd67mvt0hpu255ahntn4l72pt2v5tipjr6koa4g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor5c9h2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zunr9adh0e4l4quvotsj80mn2riu4k0glla0veug_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor5c9h2bs) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z72eb4gplvaofj7aq0nlckg1l69onunc48983i8g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor5c9h2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

ICYMI News
---

Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmn4mank27a8d4ca3mb235t5lqve2d98phttfeg8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor1c9h2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zut1hmta2prc0mrfrql22oi9dmtlc1amlrj0srj0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor1c9h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgh7njj4g1ivu1corgo12mfla2l6ovudnt69p880_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3gmeor1c9h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

name: Your America
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37335%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c93aq2x87ELC3l8%2fT99mkg&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37336%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nb0Z2yqZEbneelo%2bojvWgQ&sysid=1)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37337%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=J1JtxVhTUEOugeZ9FY6jtA&sysid=1)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37338%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YBrwp%2bmiHAyrUx%2fBvvCFow&sysid=1).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c688454%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zGK5H6TYerSXx9lYZ6evVg&sysid=1)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c688465%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UEf7F8Oectt0pUPOKpmrfg&sysid=1) I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource “The Major Characters of the End Times” as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c688466%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=A3yfULZBEsX53VZBQNeg2g&sysid=1)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God’s Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

name: American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3hu4o2qsrjji7lsd6q3snah4iipml509efnvmg0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zkvcupv94tckh3ui2prtrln4dv4lb3sopau0ur90_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2v4ej8qp48436te1s8f646lfvichhhre617q2ng_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqm8jgireod0vptimbqpaqq41dh3iumutlp8c0h8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze6sphfi04p7rs1lvfspsojvu8qq20s2dfqq1730_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3uvc4akpruk6ltvdp108k3qsrb9ma06q1sj9a88_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

name: American Action News
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrr2e32gskt97ia9edgjib5afi3nvhobkl8eeupo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb7j2ecbj539jpsert6l3ert39s59s4etdvfoi50_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk4876ll98m6e9hcsjdkk2rcih7ptrielmvp22q8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z22glnn0jgc7etogt6gon9gk0vk0uvpev23h7bqg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im8oj6c9h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---
| |
---

American Action News

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: Closing up 2023, Marching On TOWARDS CHANGE
body:
In a few days, we will turn the page on another year; I am excited, energized, motivated, and ready to hit the ground running in 2024. **I am READY to kick Sharice Davids to the curb and usher in a new level of common-sense, conservative service to the citizens of Kansas District 03.**____
____
When I filed with the FEC on June 6th, I knew that I would be taking the more difficult path. I knew I would be traveling the winding dirt road, full of twists and turns. I understood that I would be stretched and challenged** _because I am not a politician, and I am NOT following the DC playbook on how to run a campaign._**____
____
I 'm doing this **DIFFERENTLY.**____
I 've attended nearly **EIGHT HUNDRED** meetings to connect with individuals and groups.____
I 've traveled to**every corner** of our District to listen to our voters.____
I am working on building**transparent and authentic** relationships to win over the hearts and minds of the citizens in KS03.__
____
**BUT** ____
**
**
I cannot do this alone.**If you are like so many people across our nation, who are looking for real change in Washington D.C. then I encourage you to join #teamKC.**____
____
Here are ways you can show you support the winning team:____
1. **Sign up to volunteer! Our first big event of the year will be at the Kansas GOP convention in Overland Park on January 26-27. Let 's show the world that #teamKC is the one to be on. You can sign up on my website ****[www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/) or just reply to this email.____**
2. **Email me back and let's find time to have a chat.____**
3. **Please****consider making a contribution , money isn't the sole indicator of success - but it definitely helps. Donations can be made on my website at [www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/).**

When I started this campaign, I was committed to working harder than anyone out there. I am doing this. I am spending time HERE in the Third District, not in the District of Columbia. I am not just saying I'm different, _I am showing through action that I am _actually_ different._ It’s been proven over and over that the DC playbook does not work here in KS03. It’s time we elect someone who understands our community and our needs; not someone beholden to politicians in Washington.____
____
The definition of insanity is doing the same things over and over and expecting different results. Aren 't you ready for DIFFERENT?____
____
Cheers to an exciting and energizing new year!

Karen

Karen Crnkovich for Congress, KS03 ____
[www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/) ____
913-414-4446
#teamkc

PS: If you would like to be removed from our list, no problem! Please just reply to this email and we will do so.

name: Trump News HQ
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z29rf6m1drd247dsvlhn8g8f5rfre61ai923ehrg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im2o71cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ztk9smns1gv2vt8hhp9vigvmr5qie0pgrj89ufto_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im2o71cdh2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zslss1ncso79euq2236v9e7o76baenot9u2689d0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im2o71cdh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zic24c5uomrrgsnnttm7p1lo121fc5jfq3umqmqg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im2o71cdh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

The next presidential administration could be a turning point for our country.

name: Your America
subject: Who controls whom?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37342%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SoQil0Npt722yB0Fft0Ujw&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37343%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SjO5fxVh2f%2b9K9AgAHBgdQ&sysid=1)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37344%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c1rYomrfznAtbSu%2bY2gQQg&sysid=1) [NO](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37455%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wEDq5z%2fcuJzFKLvRtFFKYg&sysid=1) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37343%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SjO5fxVh2f%2b9K9AgAHBgdQ&sysid=1)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Your America News
---

subject: The truth is, no one knows for certain
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj4gnouie0vggdmlkhht1jup208lr3v97ijekk48_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im1ob6c3h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcu4i06cedh2i90b8c44fonnf14iqgh9tae4pe8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im1ob6c3h2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zomeumm051csk1sa19mivcn6larcn83s4gsj1008_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c3im1ob6c3h2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Happy New Year!_**
---
Friends, HAPPY NEW YEAR!!! We at the Indiana GOP HQ are celebrating the close of an amazing year for our party and our state. From our successful legislative session to our electoral wins in the municipal elections, 2023 was a year to remember. But it is time to look ahead. Let's carry our momentum into 2024 and continue making Indiana a better place for everyone!! We are about to enter a HUGE election year that will determine the future of both our state and our country. With your help, Indiana will continue to set the standard for conservative leadership everywhere. Let's make 2024 our BEST year yet!!! Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# _Gov. Holcomb Announced Multiple Investments in Our State!_

# FRIDAY, DECEMBER 29, 2023
---|---

## Only 3.4% of Journalists Identify as Republicans
Only 3.4% of journalists [identify as Republicans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOgzAQRL8GOiOzBoMLijR0ueqkK9EG1mEjYyPbBOXvT1x91Yz0pNHo_dynO7Jj__zCjYZsw4Rz5jdNNQgwAtTUlMtgiYBUSUPdSdW3Rna6XAetbN_UNDe46BahNdoYA4Btp7VBW5c8gARVA5hatlqa6tEp_ehRzh3KviFTNJIWziFWr8A-r2TdJ7wpVnPYSjesOe-pULcCxgLG8zyrLfmLFTCSF0cqYPR0XrEHx5nnq6Z8LB9h2S9J5BWzeB0pC9WIYAVuFHlGL17hiB4dp5wERhKR9uPhLnRNYBS3W73pb6vLOCz7yc5x0l3RyOeG7P7-5f91_QYAAP__fKNspg), compared to 36% who say they're Democrats, according to a new study of 1,600 journalists by the Newhouse School of Public Communications. The other 52% are "Independent." The study is based on a 2022 survey, the [latest in a series](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D2O6yAQAODT4C4WDP8FxWvc5bVbWhMYbCJsIpvE2tuvtPXe4NP3dZ_vWGrZl_-4Uei5zRh7-dAs4Ab-BnJWQwqZCEgOFITl0mnPrRnWEJ0xiRInGUE_lIg2ovXOq5iNA-GHEoCDFABecG24Hx9WmodDHi1yp8gzxSmV3o7x2creV8r1u33oGGPbhhrW3l8nk_8YTAym67rGvhJudJSI-7O9jx1rOfvYjoXBNOdS6WQwvZfEYFIGNbezyiSiSoaiSSoCeOc1OPBGg3ZocXylPBwhva5SazmNZYovG5b6a-h_l_wEAAD__8qAYB4) that began in 1971. At that time, 32% of journalists were Republican and 35% were Democrats. In 1982, only 19% of the media were Republicans; by 2013, ten years ago, it had dropped to 7%. The study makes no claims about the causes of the decline. A [recent Gallup poll ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyrSAQgOGnwQ5nWRSkoLiN3bltSmeF9UgGxVFyTN4-k9Sp_-Kf-d4e04NSTvvzP23s61ImCjW9eFIo0UnUU9dEvzAj64a9sqCH3oE1zeo16aCo10QzgwoRZ6UCDKHTtidDrkkeAbVCdAp6A66drTbzQBAswdCxEx1wTLWc7XtJe115yV_lxWcbytZkv9Z6XEL_EzgKHHe-r_ZJOX8cP13geJScBY69wsEogePGMZEMZV9S5D2w3KiGlS-JoIw8OZQzylzulq7jszl9PO6Uc7qMFR08N0r5d1z_dvgOAAD__934XkE)showed that the GOP has far more distrust of the media than Democrats.

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=84e1e72d5df64ec9bc6a3cdcf2502de7&_e=R3aCiEWmUI-KyzgiPF4aiWQSMa7sXYQP8p2PZQoz2M8xZ89sZOsVj-wPBmkmMzbptdU4MlVxS_F4qyN_3Ehc7bnIU88DJ5qGbNAPapJqCJ7werJ5c-SDBHR8xwZdRJgPWpiuOFclyiDyWU3llIyI7Ssm_buXP-3DVPFupHHFIKs9psNUf_ZnDS6Xp0gmEM9nzM3YnW4OtjZehlhhRJUhN8KX4lGWq-UmB9IKlkSeXgZH2FwzRD_nlUwjotkQrmqBc_T35njDU_QqDm5tfQbbRLsj-x4RDqaidnzF0aEhVYAB4f_rnW2_4bAUKgHsBs7Kad2tZqF7TFigIjB_9xUv0Hz8UTYuO4RWYb1pkHg65S3FbLdzJFzSWvu0GuW3kvUBAGnvo3_5K3H6624vxXhWT-d3bsyROebtya5avhe3TgFdAc9OIMuVtTuOhEB5-wUB)" which you can now own on DVD.

| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=84e1e72d5df64ec9bc6a3cdcf2502de7&_e=R3aCiEWmUI-KyzgiPF4aiWQSMa7sXYQP8p2PZQoz2M8xZ89sZOsVj-wPBmkmMzbptdU4MlVxS_F4qyN_3Ehc7bnIU88DJ5qGbNAPapJqCJ7werJ5c-SDBHR8xwZdRJgPWpiuOFclyiDyWU3llIyI7Ssm_buXP-3DVPFupHHFIKs9psNUf_ZnDS6Xp0gmEM9nzM3YnW4OtjZehlhhRJUhN8KX4lGWq-UmB9IKlkSeXgZH2FwzRD_nlUwjotkQrmqBc_T35njDU_QqDm5tfQbbRJbwDj0Ri-rKA9atLSwZu57WHfI8JVgV_94TSzYg8m3J3C5_-VI-44aYsa4bxopxKfWsomwvGfm_RqSd71-CuO9jXyzbdWouTvQKG20CseNTyZU7NRf4QE46SDJozxC3XY2c2XmnkMU_Qm91swQsDGMO8yS23IFm85jNKbjHRUi3)

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=84e1e72d5df64ec9bc6a3cdcf2502de7&_e=R3aCiEWmUI-KyzgiPF4aiWQSMa7sXYQP8p2PZQoz2M8xZ89sZOsVj-wPBmkmMzbptdU4MlVxS_F4qyN_3Ehc7bnIU88DJ5qGbNAPapJqCJ7werJ5c-SDBHR8xwZdRJgPWpiuOFclyiDyWU3llIyI7Ssm_buXP-3DVPFupHHFIKs9psNUf_ZnDS6Xp0gmEM9nzM3YnW4OtjZehlhhRJUhN8KX4lGWq-UmB9IKlkSeXgZH2FwzRD_nlUwjotkQrmqBc_T35njDU_QqDm5tfQbbRB9yj7ZIm7vTpjyQ127fc-1zegH3yQndEwOlI5MttLmix9ze2jXfCCHYdrWicvbGFCRz1aU1vzRF3Y1JPkN66kpwv7av_6NvOGacCyaePlGKWYdoqMEK4MkSLcdipZhOQBlPC6ZSo8sXaWOUIUVJwJo6-OeyxEcTLUS1DMxYgwe6).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

Hillsdale College

body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

| | This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a00dc31f143c38190699d9aacbc6e&_e=paz84x_s1GWpi3KAmji-ZHAwGs6Ia4pqS0JhO_5P8D2kJ3FrcCPXrXhCs1MSlWdTl9Y-5U5-jX-WgDC4CjR_yky6DknJ1WDKxGWuJncykeGRDy3tBZ_1pa6Fb4UvmDhK9ZKLxxtBUqfce-jq6ld4Ns83kWktQ8IBhzAtW0FIrK_4bnT6zi0hPjQc_JlfpxoaycrOpTdc6AskNM2uz5PnQi9gnPeZ5kFy-8cARDYKLI1CIHKn4JLTRHRbkyEssgQNMMSEUqQJMrVIF7PpitEyIq_nIc5W1M8UhQXeNjR0Gsg3jjtIFjknnTqmr7MArK0cWhxiNRdzbH_rHZ8asIdfd93IxwQZiyMbbxuL0zeAb2zC3UsDeCL9nKLfd4hOctpwyE0HUexamVyNTRihVknuxrrq5muEA6-hgf1xGiQ4FU8%3D)

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a00dc31f143c38190699d9aacbc6e&_e=paz84x_s1GWpi3KAmji-ZHAwGs6Ia4pqS0JhO_5P8D2kJ3FrcCPXrXhCs1MSlWdTl9Y-5U5-jX-WgDC4CjR_yky6DknJ1WDKxGWuJncykeGRDy3tBZ_1pa6Fb4UvmDhK9ZKLxxtBUqfce-jq6ld4Ns83kWktQ8IBhzAtW0FIrK_4bnT6zi0hPjQc_JlfpxoaycrOpTdc6AskNM2uz5PnQi9gnPeZ5kFy-8cARDYKLI1CIHKn4JLTRHRbkyEssgQNcA-Qi3A3l7jmjydshXYwI0Lsp7fLHKNvgkTxR96fW8KiJ5sjiAZl4kryUu9pCyY7l_wCap6JJXjj_TO7IrdFMMbOO2dxt7MDmYoaI-JTuJvG-VSytEew6-16scmZveSy2FfiGVnJIilqvxQripauHmp6Gf_fSemcTuxlnRdbarM%3D)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a00dc31f143c38190699d9aacbc6e&_e=paz84x_s1GWpi3KAmji-ZHAwGs6Ia4pqS0JhO_5P8D2kJ3FrcCPXrXhCs1MSlWdTl9Y-5U5-jX-WgDC4CjR_yky6DknJ1WDKxGWuJncykeGRDy3tBZ_1pa6Fb4UvmDhK9ZKLxxtBUqfce-jq6ld4Ns83kWktQ8IBhzAtW0FIrK_4bnT6zi0hPjQc_JlfpxoaycrOpTdc6AskNM2uz5PnQi9gnPeZ5kFy-8cARDYKLI1CIHKn4JLTRHRbkyEssgQNUHu1nNFI3s2P3n3SxipQuF-F0yKVDcFM-pU0JeXkRx_PhOd7vzYHKi-_cImQQYvJbPfKoSD_wLL3YC5LF0Dv2r5bmG6vc9ANXFG-etmoiVnUrT86lt4Zd6NpUfpMRaTqd87AfrRCDNW2K7o6-iT8AUrXdWpeibVgLBUakgHdHyA%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a00dc31f143c38190699d9aacbc6e&_e=paz84x_s1GWpi3KAmji-ZHAwGs6Ia4pqS0JhO_5P8D2kJ3FrcCPXrXhCs1MSlWdTl9Y-5U5-jX-WgDC4CjR_yky6DknJ1WDKxGWuJncykeGRDy3tBZ_1pa6Fb4UvmDhK9ZKLxxtBUqfce-jq6ld4Ns83kWktQ8IBhzAtW0FIrK_4bnT6zi0hPjQc_JlfpxoaycrOpTdc6AskNM2uz5PnQi9gnPeZ5kFy-8cARDYKLI1CIHKn4JLTRHRbkyEssgQNUTN2GwiiQCRfFRfYU8l5UMkrjze0KdCphaaEEzvB9_RMtQwsE2yzwlz-PaG5qdj5MlcN_d4I-TnGSbBR-SzWnynXTBJjGb5QkjGNtP-OIPp-mUDS2VDJDJorGVpamkSjj4Gs6lnmL6e3q4OB8Z8a8pWtEgcQvEURh_ikkRdSv0c%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=880a00dc31f143c38190699d9aacbc6e&_e=paz84x_s1GWpi3KAmji-ZHAwGs6Ia4pqS0JhO_5P8D2kJ3FrcCPXrXhCs1MSlWdTl9Y-5U5-jX-WgDC4CjR_yky6DknJ1WDKxGWuJncykeGRDy3tBZ_1pa6Fb4UvmDhK9ZKLxxtBUqfce-jq6ld4Ns83kWktQ8IBhzAtW0FIrK_4bnT6zi0hPjQc_JlfpxoaycrOpTdc6AskNM2uz5PnQi9gnPeZ5kFy-8cARDYKLI1CIHKn4JLTRHRbkyEssgQNiKuHQc7q6Ufor1BiwgwfABgnYMwBKi_MuQi9m9Gu9wQ2jgRQi5lXgx4x3I22xUu_NzIVW1IUvCbpH27q9BJ1SY69Hm1qVPZ64ygqBgu3PudZqfZqgulUY0f0cSuyp_Dj3M2cNIGw3dJXShq58hDWSiRtayyPuND143x8C90Ftsw%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Jerrad Christian
subject: I’m a veteran with STEM training
body:
And practically a unicorn in politics these days...
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eetZdJVVU59-RyfKBJRAQJGL3fVGVVu61RE2MdtMXT8av7f3OZw4H1LaIhOOGtk7Ujpi1TQUyBHi3eu0dbdl_Ug_yOWekSvxZk6cJFZo0AqVay1znPFBzmNxM7ncjBdgZ5sB0kobZqc1WDXrLX8eCTPrtKsvn_A0GiluNcuFNzB72AY-jwOdMA7Av2LTAjjfo0Ap0EkA72A=&c=k7gXOOEw-NfUD205MAB4FB4z9Y8pdTMwYPdX7GUwvuj5tnagbR7zRA==&ch=SrHAxw1kQEySPmxUvjqM9NNDp-hLKXo6PxwsPHwgHXhrKIJrd9n_Gw==)
---

Friend,
I served in the U.S. Navy, and during my time in the service I studied meteorology and oceanography, which is vital for guiding ships and flights to safety. Equally important was our role in anti-submarine warfare, a critical aspect of national defense.
When I decided to run for Congress so that my region of Appalachian Ohio could have the representation it sorely needs and very much deserves, I immediately realized how outnumbered folks like me are in politics:
As a veteran, I joined a small circle of people from both parties that have ever run for Congress or been elected. There are currently only about 82 members of Congress with military experience, and that share has fallen to a record low.
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eetZdJVVU59-RyfKBJRAQJGL3fVGVVu61RE2MdtMXT8av7f3OZw4H1LaIhOOGtk7Ujpi1TQUyBHi3eu0dbdl_Ug_yOWekSvxZk6cJFZo0AqVay1znPFBzmNxM7ncjBdgZ5sB0kobZqc1WDXrLX8eCTPrtKsvn_A0GiluNcuFNzB72AY-jwOdMA7Av2LTAjjfo0Ap0EkA72A=&c=k7gXOOEw-NfUD205MAB4FB4z9Y8pdTMwYPdX7GUwvuj5tnagbR7zRA==&ch=SrHAxw1kQEySPmxUvjqM9NNDp-hLKXo6PxwsPHwgHXhrKIJrd9n_Gw==)
---
And as a person with an extensive background in science, I would be in an even smaller club in Congress. Scientists, including physicians and experts in medical sciences, are even rarer in politics and serving in the halls of Congress than veterans and active duty servicemembers.
The point is, those who don't come from the legal profession, business, or finance start out at a disadvantage in fundraising.
But as more individuals get involved in supporting worthwhile campaigns and rolling up their sleeves to work for and donate to candidates they believe in, the playing field gets leveled.
[That's why my team and I make a point to reach out often to gather support for this campaign--we can build the campaign we need to win without big corporate PACs or wealthy bankrolling donors if we have you on our side. Please, if you can, contribute $10 or more to help a Navy veteran and a scientist get to Congress:](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eetZdJVVU59-RyfKBJRAQJGL3fVGVVu61RE2MdtMXT8av7f3OZw4H1LaIhOOGtk7Ujpi1TQUyBHi3eu0dbdl_Ug_yOWekSvxZk6cJFZo0AqVay1znPFBzmNxM7ncjBdgZ5sB0kobZqc1WDXrLX8eCTPrtKsvn_A0GiluNcuFNzB72AY-jwOdMA7Av2LTAjjfo0Ap0EkA72A=&c=k7gXOOEw-NfUD205MAB4FB4z9Y8pdTMwYPdX7GUwvuj5tnagbR7zRA==&ch=SrHAxw1kQEySPmxUvjqM9NNDp-hLKXo6PxwsPHwgHXhrKIJrd9n_Gw==)

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=abea47859c454ea9bb0f757ff34dcf21&_e=YG8ZFJTuF3a8DPPvGBWNrCpWI5Qhy2eOH0ZmG1DLj8BRXT_3dosktn9nCFzIBG6z4QLhrEeu09pQ44z1JveEvTa1Cl7bOF1sNtjg2b8EIYHyX8SfQnROlN0L8HFumtKD624Vn4JuuZM6_vXgJlwZmH9eBb0tTr0SRp8fz_nA-XQbIaJUJ4shYuzQrxV49V7DOQGhidX1F36YHqd0hhe_jixh2pOyM-a93EJwelolVyKB1mhuBWSAisCcgr5MYkabYzHcqSaIE-vv7EOOyIix0AVbFYbfciwWRVRpJ_hdIxwTz-mqNhuwAP1OOKTMlKexsMZIJoNWe8O3sE9iy2KIFDPtuhNZSggZQFOnp7k53CUAThNrk9D6riMoZ-wZZYcLWxBxy7RdPmGc20iHCk5sOQ%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=abea47859c454ea9bb0f757ff34dcf21&_e=YG8ZFJTuF3a8DPPvGBWNrCpWI5Qhy2eOH0ZmG1DLj8BRXT_3dosktn9nCFzIBG6z4QLhrEeu09pQ44z1JveEvTa1Cl7bOF1sNtjg2b8EIYHyX8SfQnROlN0L8HFumtKD624Vn4JuuZM6_vXgJlwZmH9eBb0tTr0SRp8fz_nA-XQbIaJUJ4shYuzQrxV49V7DOQGhidX1F36YHqd0hhe_jixh2pOyM-a93EJwelolVyLFF81YkreFvPCH6eViQsVtyKqJ3oXT0urUaHjGwx1qFADvEmO6tEn1nYPaTjHcupmhEAckyGkN9BFPfz8VR0V7zl0eCrkkQyp4AXxNFeKwvityFp64PJGei4mrLjQ6zJwJ-d37fzgevhyQqSh9tUaoHtCu55j3lDliHc9IyMWsug%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. Your vote will matter.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/325769b29581/re-hey-9338301?e=d30db4cde8)
Fellow Republican,

Your vote in 2024 matters.

That's what I wrote about in today's edition of the Daily News (https://www.virginislandsdailynews.com/opinion/republicans-caucus-is-next-month-can-v-i-votes-matter-in-presidential-race/article_c7ec0be5-f603-52b5-ac77-4335d88f58a5.html) . For those of you without a copy, here is the article:

https://www.virginislandsdailynews.com/opinion/republicans-caucus-is-next-month-can-v-i-votes-matter-in-presidential-race/article_c7ec0be5-f603-52b5-ac77-4335d88f58a5.html

Republicans caucus is next month, can V.I. votes matter in presidential race?

Many voters will cast their first-ever ballot for president of the United States in a little more than a month from now.

I will be one of them. Like most Virgin Islanders, I have never directly voted for president.

While the Republican caucus on Feb. 8, 2024, is, technically speaking, an internal party election to decide the 2024 Republican presidential nominee, it’s actually the only meaningful chance for Virgin Islanders to vote for president in 2024.

That’s significant because all of us can agree that next year’s presidential election is hugely important.

Admittedly, the Virgin Islands is relatively detached from the partisan tussles of stateside politics. It’s easy not to care when you have no vote for president in the general election, no U.S. senators, and a member in the House of Representatives without the ability to vote on final passage of legislation.

At the same time, daily life is shaped by stateside politics.

The territorial government depends on federal money; economic development incentives depend on congressional approval; federal criminal law, federal law enforcement and federal courts are critical to the administration of justice and the maintenance of the rule of law; and the broader challenges posed by illegal immigration and Chinese influence in the Caribbean and Latin America can only be addressed by Washington. Of course, there are other issues.

Unlike previous years when the V.I. Democratic and Republican parties were largely irrelevant in the nomination of their respective standard-bearer, the territory is in the spotlight this cycle.

That’s because the Feb. 8 caucus date makes it the third-overall Republican primary or caucus. It follows Iowa and New Hampshire and precedes South Carolina.

The early date has already resulted in unprecedented attention.

Eight candidates filed for the caucus ballot. Of the eight, Chris Christie, Nikki Haley, Ron DeSantis, Vivek Ramaswamy, and Donald J. Trump are still running. The Haley, DeSantis, and Trump campaigns have all campaigned here.

It started with DeSantis who headlined a fundraiser — via video — on St. Thomas. More recently, Congressman Byron Donalds and Congressman Ralph Norman were in the territory on behalf of Trump and Haley, respectively. There have been numerous other appearances by senior staff and top surrogates, including Dr. Ben Carson, a former Trump Cabinet secretary.

All the appearances signify how important the islands are to the 2024 campaign.

By going third-in-the-nation, the direction of the campaign will almost certainly be decided by Virgin Islanders.

If the same candidate wins Iowa, New Hampshire, and the territory then the race is over. Conversely, a split decision in the first two states will make the outcome of the V.I. caucus a narrative-defining moment.

While it’s a Republican caucus, any voter may cast a ballot. All someone must do is update their voter registration with the Election System to Republican.

The Feb. 8 voting locations are:

7 a.m. to 6 p.m. at La Reine Chicken Shack on St. Croix
7 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Bluebeard’s Castle on St. Thomas
10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Lovango bar on St. John

— Gordon Ackley, St. Thomas, is chairman of the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands.

With the caucus a little more than a month away, I need you to make a plan to vote. And I need you to also commit to bringing a family member, friend, or neighbor with you to polls.

As Virgin Islanders, this is our one and only chance to vote in 2024. Let's be sure our voices are heard loud and clear.

Also, I have been asked by the DeSantis and Haley campaigns to identify supporters who would like to join their leadership and steering committees. I know the Trump campaign is also putting together a team for the Virgin Islands. Are you interested in getting involved with a campaign? If so, reply to this email and I'll connect you to the campaign of your choice.

Your friend,
Gordon Ackley

But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today.
