subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=af4474add2234aa19ca9d792ec067b19&_e=Y689IR5YjK9sooWzJR6kFwrH6DP0Q4PRTA1YNQvZ9GMQTtfZQKWHwdiVELW1Q30Avbd7XvD8EMWzpdgGh1bUhm4Xl5xkHv5Zisk0dal9dXagasVTRd1kt2CjNlpAXXVglpRVOExH-0-ht8QrtnrXrqbtHwS-SyqEkBmjCy5llWwOr6c09XwlnkLw0hJ9E_WaZNWHnj2-n1ELn3kiC0kSw1-LxccJMil2KG6xs6Xujd4oO8FAI8dILUbnGXqARsaDLUlKy0RRXGwZwGrDkAzuSGMXuhEStqkZf4PZgUYjScheiATvn2pj9WGx0B9-8Jvu-f7U5o48tOuM7S4fOKm5hXhS4RoyO961bPTnt7bJh2IbibagwgGX7ymV0oB-aeMMElGWYNOl7f_uG2R-WygKHg%3D%3D)** When you think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn't be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what we're up against. **That 's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... "A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza "_The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin "David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=af4474add2234aa19ca9d792ec067b19&_e=Y689IR5YjK9sooWzJR6kFwrH6DP0Q4PRTA1YNQvZ9GMQTtfZQKWHwdiVELW1Q30Avbd7XvD8EMWzpdgGh1bUhm4Xl5xkHv5Zisk0dal9dXagasVTRd1kt2CjNlpAXXVglpRVOExH-0-ht8QrtnrXrqbtHwS-SyqEkBmjCy5llWwOr6c09XwlnkLw0hJ9E_WaZNWHnj2-n1ELn3kiC0kSw1-LxccJMil2KG6xs6Xujd4oO8FAI8dILUbnGXqARsaDm-6ATgskQEUD5IdOoX3SoOD4RD73G-AHsbwc6liWGz1StO7vgkngt9peVfbNw7nwb_cCCNSl821yHuX91vg9SvjNIyYrCwGZlK_cIVAg-G6X_ldhREn1vVhl_hE8GXrYDs8XWQwvmv34ae6CHAPjnA%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make our country better - they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama's own words "radically transform" America. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---
P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I'll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=af4474add2234aa19ca9d792ec067b19&_e=Y689IR5YjK9sooWzJR6kFwrH6DP0Q4PRTA1YNQvZ9GMQTtfZQKWHwdiVELW1Q30Avbd7XvD8EMWzpdgGh1bUhm4Xl5xkHv5Zisk0dal9dXagasVTRd1kt2CjNlpAXXVglpRVOExH-0-ht8QrtnrXrqbtHwS-SyqEkBmjCy5llWwOr6c09XwlnkLw0hJ9E_WaZNWHnj2-n1ELn3kiC0kSw1-LxccJMil2KG6xs6Xujd4oO8FAI8dILUbnGXqARsaDcFbPiRbCeoVshfWx_UAbKWK4IHrQJ92qq4z76J1Jgk8Gd0QKW73lYvKNOaG2EEIY8OVsBXy0-qp6pL3n5S5OMoOSQmA29zdmQga58EybSJq0BmzdPNVv1zmqClq6TDyA6K-5Emf_i1V4GJjswhqIPg%3D%3D)**

name: Full Mag News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3e34e895f756402885307e6766e0b867&_e=4wibxB4EoGFMoCjRWa680KQtfus6IqAWchS4QLNylidhkoXK4DxpAfHbV3UyfMd9oDhNbPsUG3OUCAQQMJomnYusftez6tpT1Vz72NzKdWNiDyRnNFJIen1Fqyx4qEZwdzQ7_2oiXAEpdlAkxa4awkE6wsvswXA9RlP3GJD9HCduJ58oJ8Y5lEcATPr8_iDMI34J3Y_ZURvaXFmhcVmBvCBDOm5Ic2vIQqd7Jv5R6LXTu0JWGliqO3p7lM8hqm4Uq7hl_-OzSgrvcsyrDwYa3ZxFbbo00FMlmLBNgf85dyqvdM-QyDpVHAcvGWyyi1Srqv3fPBh5Ynlr4kIMgW4wIppOFxmzimdvcawr4k-4za93V7wwo5McexuIYUN65NDz6skhLeXCnCQHIfiooXMhCQ%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3e34e895f756402885307e6766e0b867&_e=4wibxB4EoGFMoCjRWa680KQtfus6IqAWchS4QLNylidhkoXK4DxpAfHbV3UyfMd9oDhNbPsUG3OUCAQQMJomnYusftez6tpT1Vz72NzKdWNiDyRnNFJIen1Fqyx4qEZwdzQ7_2oiXAEpdlAkxa4awkE6wsvswXA9RlP3GJD9HCduJ58oJ8Y5lEcATPr8_iDMI34J3Y_ZURvaXFmhcVmBvCBDOm5Ic2vIQqd7Jv5R6LWpwlYQ-rMbP-W0itSess-fBM3Vv-XVrJEljpFGVYZ__8O4wcREWgHHdjpkuyNgCrZZxY9D-tTJaU5w029Ah-R616Mk0sTUiNAcW6SXtE7SEXDUP9ou0SQfBv2hRvNrS_WPW30CkQ9-eirH5FlML-5gXLQWD6MN5DsIGgvLIMZboQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. body:

| | This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=459629c186274f988f221a91e7e2c58f&_e=XeBXtje4K5CfhdU8ouImOMSbp9v2eZAEdwK3cnXhjlwyMKdHjETlLhTvgCntuOYS7Eb_XgrDKgVuvCH6VcUA7aYAPaO_xcU70W5OqLdldbU-_Azl64C9306x7IuSN2BkDJf7111DGXop7pvelFac2o0mRVLPyn9Pr5ACDQkQkNeVY_ALS25Hj-uQPvnJ25yiHV9hfO_HI7cRfPhUbdCOlXmZc_7b-G6JoQDV3PXj9XES9i50HvK1tNdY1sSH2zt1v_EQW6ntFwutmYTmpfN2kAazYXYYMylOhaDnj_ggREDqD0pLDJEmedJs0B-RHK9cMsBIBgHfub9juAGVs-70X_tHxUeBmPWePzC2SWp994gUGFtaPEIpqwKmorz82F9SXa22zWNGE_tTAedV28MH37PC84zdRbM4QeESBPSutC8%3D)

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=459629c186274f988f221a91e7e2c58f&_e=XeBXtje4K5CfhdU8ouImOMSbp9v2eZAEdwK3cnXhjlwyMKdHjETlLhTvgCntuOYS7Eb_XgrDKgVuvCH6VcUA7aYAPaO_xcU70W5OqLdldbU-_Azl64C9306x7IuSN2BkDJf7111DGXop7pvelFac2o0mRVLPyn9Pr5ACDQkQkNeVY_ALS25Hj-uQPvnJ25yiHV9hfO_HI7cRfPhUbdCOlXmZc_7b-G6JoQDV3PXj9XES9i50HvK1tNdY1sSH2zt1tsRY72-9PVjxWfv_d1FqbVBufJP0qR_RbSw5ycPMN0A0B73pMCc0ronKuoiIeDK62GUQimRVtmDlx01P86SUIBsPqPkRZzzhAvU4TC0C-5YOvabCdg8l_1qXxYSenhp2EblT1VyhxcNTnW_kIle5_rhaf_FXqQmZdcc7BQ-nacY%3D)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=459629c186274f988f221a91e7e2c58f&_e=XeBXtje4K5CfhdU8ouImOMSbp9v2eZAEdwK3cnXhjlwyMKdHjETlLhTvgCntuOYS7Eb_XgrDKgVuvCH6VcUA7aYAPaO_xcU70W5OqLdldbU-_Azl64C9306x7IuSN2BkDJf7111DGXop7pvelFac2o0mRVLPyn9Pr5ACDQkQkNeVY_ALS25Hj-uQPvnJ25yiHV9hfO_HI7cRfPhUbdCOlXmZc_7b-G6JoQDV3PXj9XES9i50HvK1tNdY1sSH2zt1uaw_Sd-KW0wftmbiwjb08ssHbWBhXSd_o7tdrgIOMYbDolg-SyXUmSs722PmfJ7WLUPyIGqkhC5w0k2NM3k4TzgsRwhwoV6l1xXw7JSDFSoqftR5kcPlfppwzeytzaQuugpQgReBj8xdJpMbjgmboD98xZxYOFAt5314b9QYtMM%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=459629c186274f988f221a91e7e2c58f&_e=XeBXtje4K5CfhdU8ouImOMSbp9v2eZAEdwK3cnXhjlwyMKdHjETlLhTvgCntuOYS7Eb_XgrDKgVuvCH6VcUA7aYAPaO_xcU70W5OqLdldbU-_Azl64C9306x7IuSN2BkDJf7111DGXop7pvelFac2o0mRVLPyn9Pr5ACDQkQkNeVY_ALS25Hj-uQPvnJ25yiHV9hfO_HI7cRfPhUbdCOlXmZc_7b-G6JoQDV3PXj9XES9i50HvK1tNdY1sSH2zt17bQ__lDAaXYaRwGGNIPSHCyNrVvr0TxbjMIcByQwA6onIRr-sUJQ75CJAiGfPB1c4uxcd8b7NUw-ma7fHsLkuGLtwH5ElOw2MdTuVLPahnteJ2Qet1UF29NujSBwIe-RFa33jerrLdzUyRnr3HpD3glj8G1lLlArl3OKlHYQfcY%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=459629c186274f988f221a91e7e2c58f&_e=XeBXtje4K5CfhdU8ouImOMSbp9v2eZAEdwK3cnXhjlwyMKdHjETlLhTvgCntuOYS7Eb_XgrDKgVuvCH6VcUA7aYAPaO_xcU70W5OqLdldbU-_Azl64C9306x7IuSN2BkDJf7111DGXop7pvelFac2o0mRVLPyn9Pr5ACDQkQkNeVY_ALS25Hj-uQPvnJ25yiHV9hfO_HI7cRfPhUbdCOlXmZc_7b-G6JoQDV3PXj9XES9i50HvK1tNdY1sSH2zt15Bgs5zW-NbBX5SxFnodf8RxI33vi56EfaqIXvs9j0RNhrrZUsHftgeGrF817_um46RWxKGsgWiCjLPax49cDNyDrJ5NwvDuKQSj1qQVvbzgQfjdt8jaA-Jv46XRdlJT0xfmrbIP0YtkwVWMk4avhNT09RyFdGD6JIJBEss0eErI%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
Don't miss out on these exclusive campaign highlights and updates! Plus, how your support is making an impact!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=08f7e13e9f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

To my donors, friends and supporters,

As we near the end of 2023, your steadfast support is truly appreciated. Despite not being a self-funder, our campaign continues to see significant success, thanks to donors like you! It's powerful knowing that each donation reflects a real Hoosier ready for positive change.

We are close to reaching the financial goals we put forth in 2023 but we need your help today to put us over the top.

Whether through a recurring contribution or a one-time gift, your generosity remains pivotal to our success.
DONATE (https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-suzanne-crouch/web?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=08f7e13e9f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** We Need Bold Leadership
------------------------------------------------------------
I've dedicated my career to positively impacting Hoosiers' lives, driven by personal experiences and a steadfast commitment to impactful policies.

The challenges facing Indiana demand bold leadership, and I️ am ready to rise to the occasion.
https://www.ibj.com/articles/gubernatorial-candidate-suzanne-crouch-wants-to-stand-out-in-the-crowd?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=08f7e13e9f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Addressing Key Issues:
------------------------------------------------------------
MENTAL HEALTH:
Mental health and substance abuse are paramount concerns, issues that have touched my family deeply.

The Indiana Mental Health Roundtable, co-founded by me in 2021, stands testament to my dedication to reducing stigma and strengthening our mental health system.
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid02GzTuPbicxkX4JpMQmZLZ8A4RmxWWU3gbAp97bwiFfUQkCZAvBoDEZXZh5XH4fKWHl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=08f7e13e9f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT:
My approach to economic development emphasizes collaboration with local communities.

I have openly scrutinized projects like the LEAP Research and Innovation District, advocating for transparency and a bottom-up strategy.

By understanding the unique challenges of local governments, we can ensure no part of Indiana is left behind.
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid026dGc1g8uigkoXX1sN24Gdw13bxbGsKGV2iqsm4RBR9djEnb5JqWAEqMHiUvG9WZ7l?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=08f7e13e9f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** With your support, we will make history.
------------------------------------------------------------

As we approach the end of this year, I reflect on the strides we've made and the challenges yet to be overcome. Your steadfast support has propelled us forward, and I am immensely grateful for each of you.

Together, we will build a stronger Indiana for future generations.

Onward and upward,

DONATE (https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-suzanne-crouch/web?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=08f7e13e9f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Hi Friend ,
Travis Nembhard here. Did you catch this email my campaign manager sent? I am out on the campaign trail doing everything I can do to ensure we win this race, flip the U.S. House, and deliver on our Democratic values for the people of VA-10. But I need your help to get it done.
Sent from my mobile device

Friend, I’m so excited to introduce myself.
I’m Spencer, and I recently joined Travis’ team as the Campaign Manager. Travis has spent his entire career defending his community and I could not be more thrilled to join this team. His experience and background is impressive and he is the new generational leader that Virginia's 10th Congressional District needs. But first we need your help.
Our first fundraising deadline is in just 3 days! This campaign is growing fast and we have big things planned for the new year. But the stakes are incredibly high and VA-10 is a must-win seat for Democrats to take back the majority so we can’t afford to enter 2024 behind pace . Will you make a contribution today and help us start out on a strong footing? We only have 3 days left and we need to raise $6,052 more to hit our goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eoqgoal_va-10]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eoqgoal_va-10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eoqgoal_va-10]
As the newest member of Team Nembhard, I’m fired up and ready to do everything I can. But at the end of the day it’s the grassroots support like yours that matters most.
That’s why our end-of-year fundraising deadline is so important – people across the country will be looking to see if we have what it takes to help flip the House. In fact, elections in Virginia are among the most expensive in the country, and we need the resources to hire field staff, get our message out, and fund our advertisements.
It's going to take all of us pitching in. Will you make a contribution before our critical end-of-year fundraising deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eoqgoal_va-10]
Thank you!
Spencer Toth
Campaign Manager

body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

| | This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0014b4a063254f47a871adbcfdf63e37&_e=YNAVAya5iNAYfKLuap_2Ykw53UWYT_NZoKFG1nDvTLmekzhQwtYLyqSOKoZfNkGfBIBSOnbQZhMNSqQA30ncsLomMr5SKt9P6wGjoGiDrgPAZmWX4RkATDzgdNrgUokHl_xQvyxtIFU2BJls4EBIiLa-aF7SA69YKA4ihUphzM18LcTAwWyY1S0aIDnD8q5nuR_VEOHQn0-fXTzEsd-0pZ_DuIDrdpFKibWBQ28uOQRXVYsSChCklZZNZqsql5KehsAZ0VULgico6Fqfzyi8EtmhOyviJ_R5uWLuOhLLylx8RUOqEyhVFpxow1dwl91HaYGOKR1VL0rFDlfC_Gb-7Sm2Rw_0uxvixuKQCX6YZF2z_bt6h2ydGoffX8QmyVIleHkdRBgMUjOvpBMLCJCfP4GxCBJi4_QUkpNPnU19nq0%3D)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0014b4a063254f47a871adbcfdf63e37&_e=YNAVAya5iNAYfKLuap_2Ykw53UWYT_NZoKFG1nDvTLmekzhQwtYLyqSOKoZfNkGfBIBSOnbQZhMNSqQA30ncsLomMr5SKt9P6wGjoGiDrgPAZmWX4RkATDzgdNrgUokHl_xQvyxtIFU2BJls4EBIiLa-aF7SA69YKA4ihUphzM18LcTAwWyY1S0aIDnD8q5nuR_VEOHQn0-fXTzEsd-0pZ_DuIDrdpFKibWBQ28uOQRXVYsSChCklZZNZqsql5Keo9sAAAQ2Tko80bCkAkkgdEdZ2KxuW1KmUz0unqWC7Di48KKcMvTwMoV4XCm-XoPPHYAEw_VYoaAPcfh06bjzS1wGHP-h78aadoxt9hwDU7l7ANzRazCxAQ4MTfbiTfk-NrUyZMRppFJibm6dQj0JkKW3kqgxTJij0Ii8XeAJKcQ%3D)**

name: Team Daniels
subject: Our Top 3 Countdown! (#2) Living Our Values!
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
We hope you are enjoying the final days of 2023 and the holiday season! Here at Team Daniels, we’re hard at work getting ready to beat insurrectionist Congressman Scott Perry in 2024.
We’re asking for your help to reach our online fundraising goal before midnight on Sunday, 12/31, and sharing with you the top 3 reasons that you should support Shamaine Daniels for Congress in PA-10.
CLICK HERE to make a contribution today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Reason #2 to support Shamaine Daniels for Congress - Shamaine is a lifelong Democrat who is dedicated to our Democratic values.
As a member of the City Council, Shamaine has reflected our values by fighting for things like affordable housing, but her dedication to the issues we care about started long before she became an elected official.
Shamaine and her family immigrated to the United States when she was a child. She understands the pursuit of the American Dream because her family came to this country to do just that.
As an attorney focused on immigration and civil rights, Shamaine has fought for workers and those coming to the United States to pursue their American Dream. In fact, Shamaine was one of the lead attorneys in the famous case of Lozano v. City of Hazleton [https://www.aclupa.org/en/cases/lozano-v-city-hazleton] , Where she successfully worked to overturn a law that would have infringed on the rights of thousands.
Beyond her career as a member of the City Council and an attorney, Shamaine has long supported the Dauphin County Democratic Party, the National Organization for Women (NOW), and the work of Planned Parenthood. Because of that work, NOW recently endorsed Shamaine’s campaign.
Shamaine cares deeply about the quality of life of the District’s residents, and has worked to improve the lives of families in PA-10 as a Board member of the Art Association of Harrisburg and supporter of the work of Pennsylvania CASA, which provides in-depth support for children in our juvenile system. Whether it was fighting for workers' and immigrant rights, protecting women’s ability to make their own healthcare decisions, or fighting to better the lives of the residents of Harrisburg and PA, Shamaine has led a life of public service.
If you want more members of Congress who will fight for our Democratic priorities, then Shamaine Daniels deserves your support! Please make a contribution to our campaign now, so we can reach our online fundraising goal before midnight on Sunday! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Shamaine has lived the values we want to see reflected in the United States Congress. She is a Democratic candidate whom you can be proud to support, and that is why we are asking for your help today.
Thank you for your ongoing support!
- Team Daniels

When I first read this TIME article, it gutted me. And so have the countless other stories of those who've suffered because anti-choice Republicans have cut off their access to abortion care.
**Next year, we are up against not one, but two extremist anti-choice candidates in the Republican primary for our race: Brian Fitzpatrick and Mark Houck.**
In fact, Mark Houck is so anti-choice he declared on the radio that "rape and incest is not a good excuse" for someone to get an abortion. It's a disgusting, callous belief that is exactly how you end up with 13-year-olds being forced to give birth.
**Here's where I stand on abortion and your right to choose:**
* I believe that access to abortion is essential to protecting the rights of women to freely participate in society.
* I believe YOU know best when it comes to your healthcare – not me or any politician.
* **Everyone loves someone who has had an abortion.** Nearly 1 in 4 women will have an abortion in their lifetimes.
* It is not enough to restore Roe. We need to make sure everyone in this country, regardless of zip code or economic status, can access the full range of healthcare that they need – not just reproductive care, but all care.

This is House Democratic Whip Katherine Clark. I want to take a moment to explain why this end-of-year fundraising push is so important, especially for my colleague, Emilia Sykes.

At the end of each quarter, fundraising numbers are submitted by campaigns to the Federal Election Commission (or the FEC), which are then published for everyone to see.

**And when I say everyone, I mean _everyone._** Dark money GOP super PACs, extreme right wing groups, and national Republican megadonors are watching, especially now that we’ll be entering an election year.

Posting strong numbers, including the total number of grassroots donors who support this important work, will showcase the strength and momentum behind taking back the House and putting Democrats in charge.

On the flip side, showing _any_ signs of vulnerability could invite attacks from the right. **This is particularly true for Emilia — she’s one of the top targets of extreme MAGA Republicans who are raising record-breaking amounts of money to flip this seat and expand their majority in the House.**

The millions the GOP raises will directly translate to the size and scope of attack ads they’ll lob against Democrats, so grassroots support has a huge impact in our ability to fight back.

Hitting this goal means that Emilia and I will have the resources we need to respond to any attacks, build winning campaigns, and flip the House blue.

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

| | | A recording of a phone call Trump made to Michigan election officials in 2020 has surfaced, revealing exactly what he said while urging them not to certify the election results from Detroit. Trump demanded the two election officials reject the actual results, insisting, "We can't let these people take our country away from us." [**These new revelations add to Trump's pattern of improperly and illegally pressuring state officials after the 2020 election, and trying to overturn the results and subvert our democracy. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70301d36-e383-4159-8fa8-0c561807f5df/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We need Trump to be held accountable for all of his crimes. This phone call must be investigated, and if there is sufficient evidence, he needs to be charged. Trump is an ongoing threat to our democracy. Friends -
We’re just two days away from our important Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline: On December 31st, we will close the books on the final fundraising quarter of the year. Given that your inbox is likely full of emails from campaigns like mine ringing the alarm bells, I thought I’d throw in a bit of history to explain the context of all the kerfuffle that comes with these deadlines – and why so many campaigns, including my own, are in your inbox asking for donations right now.
If you already know how important these deadlines are, please use this link to make a contribution to our campaign today: **[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/December-Deadline](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231229-1-tt&t=2&akid=969%2E135344%2EAFPnJS)**
Each year, candidates running for federal office face four official quarterly fundraising deadlines – March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31. After these deadlines pass, we are legally required to report how much money we’ve raised and the number of donations we receive. Campaigns will have to file their reports by January 31st.
These deadlines were put into law in 1974 by the FEC Act. This was driven by reports of serious financial abuses in the 1972 presidential campaign. The FEC Act created limits for how much individuals could contribute to a campaign and established the Federal Election Commission. Since then, candidates running for federal office have to report what they raised, how much they spent, and how many individual donations they received four times a year.
Unlike many in politics, I won’t give you a made-up emergency or try to convince you that the sky is falling with these FEC deadlines. But these quarterly reports do set the tone for what this campaign can accomplish in the coming months. Friends and competitors alike watch these numbers and make critical decisions for the road ahead.
[**So this is why I ask, and where it comes from. If you’d like to help us knock this FEC deadline out of the park, please consider chipping in $3 below. The sky will NOT fall if you don’t contribute, the country will NOT descend into chaos – but you WILL help us compete in one of the country’s most competitive Senate races! And isn’t that worth it?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231229-1-tt&t=3&akid=969%2E135344%2EAFPnJS)**

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to look back on the past year with me and celebrate our wins.
This year, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago, and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
Later this year, **I released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my brand-new cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are heading into one of the most difficult election years in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. subject: My Path to Embracing Faith and Fostering Unity
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laura Jones for Congress
body:
In my pursuit as a candidate for US Congress in Texas's 8th district, I've made connecting with people a cornerstone of my mission... | | | | | [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=ebc8928018&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
# Embracing Faith and Fostering Unity

**Peter -**
Reflecting on the significance of engaging where communities gather, particularly in places of faith, and the warm welcome I've received, I wanted to share this personal insight. [**But before delving deeper, I'm reaching out to ask for your support by considering a donation to our campaign today. Your contribution could truly make a profound impact on our efforts for Texas's 8th district.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=6529935465&e=a2a46ff12c)
In my pursuit as a candidate for US Congress in Texas's 8th district, I've made connecting with people a cornerstone of my mission. One significant place where communities converge is within places of worship. Engaging in worship services has provided me a connection to the community.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=546986c461&e=a2a46ff12c)

However, growing up in a deeply sheltered and religious environment, I navigated my own path, ultimately encountering challenges in adulthood. Revisiting church posed initial hurdles, but as a political candidate, I recognized the importance of engaging where people gather.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=9b2b541fb6&e=a2a46ff12c)
Venturing into various places of worship, I've been warmly received despite some differing political perspectives. This experience reshaped my view of the purpose of church, reinforcing my belief in the unifying strength of shared goals and unity.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=3b9bd0d291&e=a2a46ff12c)
Despite our diverse backgrounds, our common love for the community unites us in our joint efforts to aid those in need.
I am grateful for the life I lead, my wonderful neighbors, and the community I am honored to serve. Your warm welcome inspires me to remain engaged and present in every community. Let’s keep working towards a better district here in TX-8. Thank you for your ongoing support.

[**The people of District 8 and communities throughout it are deserving of compassionate, fair representation. I am ready to be a part of that representation. If you can stand by me in this and chip in today, I would appreciate it so mu**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=e4c4d3fc17&e=a2a46ff12c)**ch.**
| [Support This Campaign!](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=440d5a6f32&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
Thank you for listening and learning a little more about me and why this means so much.

\- Laura

body:
Here’s the situation, Peter. From protecting abortion access to the future of our democracy itself, it’s all on the line in 2024. That’s why we can’t waste the opportunity we have right now to make a meaningful impact in the next elections.

From now until midnight on Dec. 31, a generous group of donors will MATCH every gift up to our $50,000 end-of-year goal! Will you make a year-end gift to Emerge now – while every donation is doubled – to empower Democratic women to run for office in 2024 and beyond?

[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/Emerge2023

With Emerge’s unique and powerful programs, we’ve trained over 6,000 women all across the U.S. to run bold campaigns and rally thousands of neighbors for real change. Right now, more than 1,200 Emerge alums are serving in elected office!

Put it this way: Emerge’s candidates achieved a stunning 74 percent overall win rate in the November elections. And our FIRST-TIME candidates won at 56 percent – a 40+ point jump from candidates without our training!

That means Emerge is leading the way in bringing new voices and fresh perspectives to every level of our government. We’re focused on empowering women of the New American Majority – Black, Brown, and Indigenous women and women of color, as well as LGBTQ+, young, and unmarried women – so that we can build a truly representative government for the FIRST time in our country’s history.

That’s what we need to secure our essential rights for decades to come and achieve policies that put people first. But our victories this year wouldn’t have been possible without your generous support, Peter. We hope we can count on you again now as we take our movement forward. But none of our victories this year would be possible without Emerge community members like you, Peter. We’re counting on your help right now, at this crucial opportunity for our movement.

So please, make your year-end gift to Emerge now to help Democratic women run and win, from our school boards to the U.S. Congress!

http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/Emerge2023

Thank you so much for your support,

Brianna Carmen
Political Director, Emerge

A boy who couldn't wait to serve his country and a man who knows the meaning of sacrifice.

A boy who wanted to be just like his dad and a man who has three children of his own.

A boy whose family worked hard to make ends meet and a man who's running for the U.S. Senate.

My name is Sam Brown. I'm a retired Army Captain, a father, a conservative, and a Christian.

And most recently, I'm a candidate for Nevada's U.S. Senate seat.

But one thing I'm not is a politician -- in fact, I've never held elected office in my life.

That means that I'm not beholden to special interests or corrupt D.C. elites.

**But it also means that I don 't have the big money megadonors that are fueling my opponents' campaigns.**

That's why I'm reaching out to you, Friend.

I don't need special interests to fund our campaign.

I don't need big money megadonors.

I don't need D.C. elites.

**All I need is YOU, Friend.**

Here's how you can help me win this Senate seat:

**1 - Your Prayers:** Running for the U.S. Senate is a tremendous undertaking. It's something that I can't do all by myself. I'd be honored and humbled to be included in your prayers as I take on this tremendous challenge to serve the country I love.

**2 - Your Voice:** This is going to be an all-out effort. Sharing my posts on social media or forwarding this email to a few friends will go a long way in ensuring that my message reaches Americans far and wide.

Friend, together, we can show the D.C. establishment that they can't buy this Senate seat.

**[Can I count on your support?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=860e4810f277420880d8e9721d401fca&_e=dRQx8PogigYZE-QvlcVYEBOUdLMFAvhGsLBqk0ppXCiMO2qO2x1mCqoyNNa_0dnQY_PtMK6sMtdaN-Ph7M300nUXLrDXmbWLj7FnWkjNEXpUI0NCKN1o2KwNfumMamthchSXeOAgkb7x8qlOF9HiAsAsTKRCFXzGoel1EOuOE16fkRdfg9vhEPZElr_P6ATRrFkEH0wVxjjVKMEGn9c-0OCZHdnt80AIZrm7gY3xasTZQ-T5vQfr7ksWmI4iXyy88_3sn94HfS_36ft9D6eBMveC7g_F6s7Bfv7m8MMmKI4HoaI0z5hFjA-krW_1AtgIIOWCeV4Imq69NjbjflBKdQ%3D%3D "Can I count on your support?")**

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

body:
MSNBC called this Congressional District a battleground seat. We've built a movement based on uniting all Republican on one mission - take back MI03. | | | | | [](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=2b89b4af60&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
**Friend,**
What a year! In September, I announced my candidacy for Michigan’s 3rd Congressional District. For the past four months, I have been working around the clock to hear directly from the voters of West Michigan. One message I've heard loud and clear: “ _We want better leadership and to be proud of our country again._ ”
**So, let’s recap all that has happened since I joined the race in September....**
* MI03 (this district) was listed as a **battleground** district by national media. This means that national polls show we’re more than a serious contender.
* **Hillary Scholten** was listed as one of the hardest Members of Congress to work for after she lost two Chiefs of Staff and a Deputy Chief of Staff in her first 10 months of holding office.
* Congress shut down for a crucially important three weeks after Hillary Scholten **voted to oust** former Speaker Kevin McCarthy.
* Russia-Ukraine conflict raged on with virtually **no American leadership** and no plan or end in sight.
* Israel was **brutally attacked** by Hamas on October 7th.
* Rashida Tlaib shouted **anti-semitic statements** to crowds in her district and pro-Palestinian protesters attacked the Democratic National Committee while Rep Dingell and Hillary Scholten were inside the building, claiming it “rattled me more than January 6th did.”
* **Inflation** and sky-high prices persisted. Biden’s Press Secretary claimed otherwise.
* Democrats voted to limit the number of gas-powered vehicles made by auto manufacturers - unbelievably **short sighted legislating** by Hillary Scholten and the Michigan Democrats who should know how important auto manufacturing is to our region.
* Republican George Santos was **expelled** from the House of Representatives for deceptive and fraudulent behavior.
* Democrat Senator Bob Menendez was charged with **conspiracy and bribery** , yet has retained his seat in the Senate.
* Presidents of America’s most elite academic institutions **failed to condemn** calls for Jewish genocide on their campuses and were subsequently ripped to shreds for their intellectual dishonesty by the public in a much needed moment of unity.
* **Government shutdown** was narrowly avoided following Rep. Mike Johnson’s introduction to the House as Speaker.
* **Gavin Newsom** unofficially launched his backup candidacy to President Biden by touring China then returned home to clean up the streets of San Francisco all for President Xi.
* Michigan House and Senate maps created by the “non-partisan” commission were deemed **unconstitutional**.
* Texas passed a law allowing Governor Abbott to arrest **illegal migrants**.
* Arizona called on the National Guard due to severe impacts of the **crisis at the southern border**.

This was all in four months: it’s absurd. I want my kids to be proud of their country and those who lead it. Right now, I can’t look them in the eyes and say that I am confident in our leaders in Washington - this is exactly why I’m asking for your vote, we need to make a change in DC.
| | | | | | | | | [](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=f0aec36d27&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
|
# Agriculture
We spoke with agricultural leaders around West Michigan, like the Swanson’s of Ravenna, who own and operate a nationally significant, multi-generational family pickle farm.
---
| | | | | | | | |
# Veterans
Our veterans have given up so much for our country, even though the country hasn’t always given it back. It was an honor to celebrate veterans day with my son and local veterans in Grand Rapids.
---
|
---
# Voters
Everyone is welcome in my tent, grassroots, business owners, disruptors, etc. - this Republican is about limiting federal powers so our businesses may flourish and you may preserve your freedoms to be left alone by your government.
| | | | | | | | |
# Legacy
Gerald Ford gave us a lot to be proud of. He was a master negotiator, a charismatic leader, and a man of integrity. Our party must return to the decency of Gerald Ford, Vern Ehlers, and Paul Henry, who all once held this seat in order to gain the trust of voters.
---
|
---
# Manufacturing
We visited West Michigan manufacturers in a variety of industries and discussed everything from supply chain and labor to inflation and government regulations.
| [DONATE](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=3665a5e8bb&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
Despite all of that, I don’t believe we should be discouraged by recent events. We are a great nation, made up of incredible people, with good intentions. We may differ at times, but we all share values that have allowed our country to prosper: limited government, economic freedom, and individual liberty.
Now, for my least favorite part of this candidacy job...I need to ask for your help. We’re running a campaign against the DNC and a Democrat candidate who can raise money by the bucket load from California and NYC. If you can afford to chip in a few dollars, I will be eternally grateful.
[**$10, $25, $35...anything you can do to help us spread the message that changes must be made in Washington, DC.**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=db0b2baf2f&e=26f66c7cbd)
**Thank you** for your supporting my campaign thus far. 2024 is the year of change and it’s up to us all to actively engage in our politics. After all, it’s our civic duty.
God Bless,**\- Paul Hudson**

Debbie grew up in a one room apartment, and her mother — an immigrant from Ecuador — worked tirelessly to provide a better life for Debbie and her sisters, so they could achieve their American dream. I grew up with six brothers and sisters in a two room house in Jacksonville. My mom worked as a maid, and my dad was a janitor. We both know what it means to work hard and persevere.

Debbie and I also grew up working minimum wage jobs, and yet we went on to serve in Congress together. We've dedicated our careers to public service because we want every Floridian to have the opportunities we had — to ensure the American dream is within reach for _each and every one of them._
But do you know who is standing in the way of the American dream for far too many Floridians? Our extremist Senator, Rick Scott, who is beholden to a disgraced, twice-impeached former president, Donald Trump.

A mere 40% of Floridians view Rick Scott favorably, friend. It's no wonder why. **But Scott spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this Senate seat in 2018, and he's already spent millions this time around in his efforts to repeat history.**

Experts everywhere are saying this will be one of the most competitive — _and expensive_ — races in the country. I know that Debbie can defeat Rick Scott and deliver the leadership Florida deserves, but only with the power of a grassroots movement fueled by people like you, friend.

Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm, born-and-raised Missourian.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in $10 or whatever you can afford toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Missouri.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40565?refcode=em20231229-4487&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4487%2E614464%2E_y3ZUe) But first, please give me a moment to explain what my home state is up against in this election and why I’m supporting Lucas.**
**[CHIP IN TO SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40565?refcode=em20231229-4487&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4487%2E614464%2E_y3ZUe)**
Most of my family is from a town called Ste. Genevieve. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in out-of-touch culture wars and selling us his book all about “manhood” — telling the whole world that the only way to be a man is to be exactly like him.
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can give speeches or write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.
Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.

Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HcCrK4z06IvfoprnNMKnFg~~/AARclAA~/RgRncZisP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmxlYWRlcnNoaXBpbnN0aXR1dGUub3JnL3JnYy0wODI0MjQvP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1yaWxleV9hcHBlYWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVYyLVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyOFcDc3BjQgplgyLqjmXTW4GuUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HcCrK4z06IvfoprnNMKnFg~~/AARclAA~/RgRncZisP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmxlYWRlcnNoaXBpbnN0aXR1dGUub3JnL3JnYy0wODI0MjQvP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1yaWxleV9hcHBlYWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVYyLVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyOFcDc3BjQgplgyLqjmXTW4GuUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

| | | | | Peter, Donald Trump leveled yet another vile personal attack against me recently at an Iowa campaign rally, riling up his crowd and online MAGA supporters, and here’s why it matters: California’s Republican presidential primary and our Senate primary elections both fall on Super Tuesday, March 5. Trump’s legions of MAGA supporters are all eligible to vote in our Senate primary election. We will have to respond to Trump’s lies and attacks by then. So before I share the ugly details, [will you rush a split contribution of $25 or anything you can afford between Blue Amp Action and my campaign to help fight back and respond?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc147194a-1c1b-4c7f-ba2d-f5f25477c163/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb0a7dfbc-e8dc-488c-9400-a766e6c0eea3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) “Adam Shifty Schiff, with a neck like a pencil. I said, how does he hold up that fat, ugly face, with a neck — Pencil Neck. We call him Pencil Neck. What a dishonest guy.” Peter, I have to tell you — being accused of dishonesty (let alone a fat ugly face) by none other than Donald Trump is a badge of honor that I will always wear proudly. Because it shows he is afraid of me. And he should be. I hold him accountable and don’t let him run over me like he does so many others. But this is bigger than just me. Trump loathes being held accountable to the Constitution and our democracy, and he lashes out against anyone who will defend them. His attacks on me, on judges and prosecutors, on the press, are an attack on our entire constitutional order of government, and with California’s 22 million registered voters preparing to vote on Super Tuesday, we cannot let Trump’s attack go unanswered. [So Peter, rush a split contribution of any amount between Blue Amp Action and my Senate campaign to help me respond to Trump’s latest vile personal attack. I need you with me today.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T09a48765-345a-4544-8daf-7e121874e000/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Hi team, In Michigan, we’ve fought like hell to protect our fundamental rights from MAGA extremists by repealing an extreme 1931 anti-abortion law and enacting the _Reproductive Health Act_ , which protects _and_ expands access to abortion. But our fight will continue in 2024 as we fight like hell to stop MAGA extremists from winning and passing extreme, restrictive abortion bans nationwide. There aren't many Republicans in Congress with records quite as extreme as Ken Calvert's.
Democracy:
No on certifying President Biden's victory in 2020
LGBTQ issues:
No on the Matthew Shepard & James Byrd Hate Crimes Prevention Act
No on recognizing gay marriage nationally, and sought to ban it in California
He publicly outed a former Democratic opponent
Women’s rights:
No on the right to Contraception Act
No on the Violence Against Women Act
No on the Equal Rights Amendment
No on the Fair Pay Act
Sensible gun laws:
No on assault weapons ban
No on expanding background checks
No on the Protecting Our Kids Act
Yes to expand conceal and carry laws
Yes to protect firearms manufacturers from lawsuits
The environment:
No on the Inflation Reduction Act which made historic investments in clean energy
No on protecting people from toxic incinerators
No on recovering America’s wildlife
No on investing in transportation and water infrastructure
No on cracking down on oil company price gouging
I've said this before, and I still mean it: Lives are at stake in the coming 2024 elections. LGBTQ+ rights are at stake. Our democracy is at stake. The right to choose is at stake -- and so much more.
Stopping the GOP from retaining House control starts by ousting Ken Calvert here in CA-41. That's why I'm all in on electing Will Rollins, and it's why I'm counting on your support. The Special Election was declared just days ago & I launched my campaign immediately- but the liberal Governor of New York didn't want to give us any time to build momentum & mount a serious challenge.

And now we have just weeks before voting begins.

But I've started from scratch before & I'm no stranger to being an underdog.

And the support this email generates will quite literally decide whether we keep this seat red- or whether Joe Biden walks away with another win.

Peter,

There aren't many Republicans in Congress with records quite as extreme as Ken Calvert's.

_Democracy:_
No on certifying President Biden's victory in 2020

_LGBTQ issues:_
No on the Matthew Shepard & James Byrd Hate Crimes Prevention Act
No on recognizing gay marriage nationally and sought to ban it in California
He publicly outed a former Democratic opponent

_Women’s rights:_
No on the right to Contraception Act
No on the Violence Against Women Act
No on the Equal Rights Amendment
No on the Fair Pay Act

_Sensible gun laws:_
No on assault weapons ban
No on expanding background checks
No on the Protecting Our Kids Act
Yes, to expand conceal and carry laws
Yes, to protect firearms manufacturers from lawsuits

_The environment:_
No on the Inflation Reduction Act, which made historic investments in clean energy
No on protecting people from toxic incinerators
No on recovering America’s wildlife
No on investing in transportation and water infrastructure
No on cracking down on oil company price gouging

**I've said this before, and I still mean it: Lives are at stake in the coming 2024 elections. LGBTQ+ rights are at stake. Our democracy is at stake. The right to choose is at stake -- and so much more.**

body:
Disinformation is winning. It’s time for a new plan.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76028293/446447399/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzkxNTY5N2UtNjdhNi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=k31ymCMz8ulDFYCpXALxwLTgoDBSjGlaiEKqS9LM-EA=&emci=2cc069a2-9ea5-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=3915697e-67a6-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=14016711)
Peter — America is stuck in a dangerous information crisis.
**Fox News. Elon Musk. The Daily Caller.** Powerful right-wing engines of misinformation are endlessly spreading lies and hate.
_But why exactly is our media landscape so broken?_
First, quality local newsrooms are disappearing.
Second, powerful right-wing interests are running mass disinformation campaigns 24/7 across every platform possible — sowing doubt, inflaming divisions, and causing political violence like we saw on January 6th.
**If you feel like we’re at a perilous crossroads, you’re not alone.**
**On cable news, social media, and even the dark web, right-wing bad actors keep doubling down on propaganda and lies.** Without viable alternatives, millions of Americans find themselves trapped in an echo chamber of bad information and fake news.
**That's where we come in.**
**Here at Courier Newsroom, we’re fighting back by building the largest left-leaning network of local newsrooms in America.** We neutralize bad information by reporting factual, relevant news and information, delivered directly to those who need it most.
We already have local newsrooms in 10 battleground states staffed by real journalists who live in the communities we serve, and we’re ready to expand our network.
To do that, we need your help to spread the word about the great reporting published by our talented team of journalists every day. **We know that the best antidote to disinformation is more good information** , and that’s what our newsrooms take pride in delivering at Courier Newsroom.
**Now, here’s where you come in.** We’re only able to offer free, accessible local news because grassroots supporters like you chip in what they can, when they can.
[**We have a goal of raising $15,000 before the end of the year to grow our network of left-leaning local newsrooms and fight back against dangerous lies and disinformation. Here at Courier Newsroom, we’re fighting back by building the largest left-leaning network of local newsrooms in America. We neutralize bad information by reporting factual, relevant news and information, delivered directly to those who need it most. We already have local newsrooms in 10 battleground states staffed by real journalists who live in the communities we serve, and we’re ready to expand our network. To do that, we need your help to spread the word about the great reporting published by our talented team of journalists every day. We know that the best antidote to disinformation is more good information , and that’s what our newsrooms take pride in delivering at Courier Newsroom. Now, here’s where you come in. We’re only able to offer free, accessible local news because grassroots supporters like you chip in what they can, when they can. = **= Thank you! body:
Read today's newspaper.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/e8049dd250c8/re-hey-9338397?e=d30db4cde8)
Fellow Republican,

Your vote in 2024 matters.

That's what I wrote about in today's edition of the Daily News (https://www.virginislandsdailynews.com/opinion/republicans-caucus-is-next-month-can-v-i-votes-matter-in-presidential-race/article_c7ec0be5-f603-52b5-ac77-4335d88f58a5.html) . For those of you without a copy, here is the article:

https://www.virginislandsdailynews.com/opinion/republicans-caucus-is-next-month-can-v-i-votes-matter-in-presidential-race/article_c7ec0be5-f603-52b5-ac77-4335d88f58a5.html

Republicans caucus is next month, can V.I. votes matter in presidential race?

Many voters will cast their first-ever ballot for president of the United States in a little more than a month from now.

I will be one of them. Like most Virgin Islanders, I have never directly voted for president.

While the Republican caucus on Feb. 8, 2024, is, technically speaking, an internal party election to decide the 2024 Republican presidential nominee, it’s actually the only meaningful chance for Virgin Islanders to vote for president in 2024.

That’s significant because all of us can agree that next year’s presidential election is hugely important.

Admittedly, the Virgin Islands is relatively detached from the partisan tussles of stateside politics. It’s easy not to care when you have no vote for president in the general election, no U.S. senators, and a member in the House of Representatives without the ability to vote on final passage of legislation.

At the same time, daily life is shaped by stateside politics.

The territorial government depends on federal money; economic development incentives depend on congressional approval; federal criminal law, federal law enforcement and federal courts are critical to the administration of justice and the maintenance of the rule of law; and the broader challenges posed by illegal immigration and Chinese influence in the Caribbean and Latin America can only be addressed by Washington. Of course, there are other issues.

Unlike previous years when the V.I. Democratic and Republican parties were largely irrelevant in the nomination of their respective standard-bearer, the territory is in the spotlight this cycle.

That’s because the Feb. 8 caucus date makes it the third-overall Republican primary or caucus. It follows Iowa and New Hampshire and precedes South Carolina.

The early date has already resulted in unprecedented attention.

Eight candidates filed for the caucus ballot. Of the eight, Chris Christie, Nikki Haley, Ron DeSantis, Vivek Ramaswamy, and Donald J. Trump are still running. The Haley, DeSantis, and Trump campaigns have all campaigned here.

It started with DeSantis who headlined a fundraiser — via video — on St. Thomas. More recently, Congressman Byron Donalds and Congressman Ralph Norman were in the territory on behalf of Trump and Haley, respectively. There have been numerous other appearances by senior staff and top surrogates, including Dr. Ben Carson, a former Trump Cabinet secretary.

All the appearances signify how important the islands are to the 2024 campaign.

By going third-in-the-nation, the direction of the campaign will almost certainly be decided by Virgin Islanders.

If the same candidate wins Iowa, New Hampshire, and the territory then the race is over. Conversely, a split decision in the first two states will make the outcome of the V.I. caucus a narrative-defining moment.

While it’s a Republican caucus, any voter may cast a ballot. All someone must do is update their voter registration with the Election System to Republican.

The Feb. 8 voting locations are:

7 a.m. to 6 p.m. at La Reine Chicken Shack on St. Croix
7 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Bluebeard’s Castle on St. Thomas
10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Lovango bar on St. John

— Gordon Ackley, St. Thomas, is chairman of the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands.

With the caucus a little more than a month away, I need you to make a plan to vote. And I need you to also commit to bringing a family member, friend, or neighbor with you to polls.

As Virgin Islanders, this is our one and only chance to vote in 2024. Let's be sure our voices are heard loud and clear.

Also, I have been asked by the DeSantis and Haley campaigns to identify supporters who would like to join their leadership and steering committees. I know the Trump campaign is also putting together a team for the Virgin Islands. Are you interested in getting involved with a campaign? If so, reply to this email and I'll connect you to the campaign of your choice.

Your friend,
Gordon Ackley

Derek,
I really need to talk to you about my friend Bob Casey. The 2024 election is approaching fast -- **and the GOP’s road to winning back the Senate runs right through PA.**
Republicans are zeroing in on 2024’s battleground states as we speak. You can bet Mitch McConnell and the GOP’s shadiest billionaires will spend hundreds of million$ to attack Bob.
We’ve *got* to keep Bob Casey fighting for working people alongside me in the Senate. So before our end-of-year fundraising deadline, I have to ask:

subject: This is the most exciting piece of work I have ever been a part of. No BS.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
There’s not a human being reading this message that can’t lay claim to this issue.

Friends -
This March, Californians will vote on an important ballot initiative — a once-in-a-generation reform to help people with serious mental illness and substance abuse problems get out of the shadows and out of encampments, and into the housing and treatment facilities they need to get better.
This is the most exciting piece of work I have ever been a part of, and that is no BS.
It touches more people, more directly, in more ways, and on more days than anything I've done in office. And I want you to know about it.
Because not only can it work in California, but it can be a model for the country.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/3090?t=1&akid=1746%2E4767699%2E5hoAqw)
The plan will save people’s lives. It will give peace of mind to their families. It will make our communities safer.
There’s not a human being reading this message that can’t lay claim to this issue.
Some of us more intimately than others.
No state has ever done anything at the level I am proposing, and it's important to me that you know about it:
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/3093?t=2&akid=1746%2E4767699%2E5hoAqw)
People want to see people off the streets and they want to know that when their loved one is in crisis that they are going to get the quality care they deserve.
This is solvable.
And in California, we will solve it.
\- Gavin Newsom
* * *
🌤️ **Hi.** Please don’t click away just yet. 🏡
Our mental health ballot initiative will come to a vote early next year and we need your support to get it passed.
If everyone reading this donated just $20 today, we’d have the resources to pass Prop 1 and get people who are struggling with acute mental illness the help they need. If that sounds worth $20, please make a donation to Gavin Newsom’s ballot measure committee today.

| | The year we’ve been waiting for is finally here. **2024 will be the ultimate showdown in U.S. elections. It will not be a repeat of 2020.** Here’s why:
---
1. **Americans are engaged.** We’ve lived through the lies and seen the truth continue to be revealed and affirmed. No, not everyone feels this way, but the numbers are in our favor. And more join our ranks every day. We are uniting.
2. **Americans are ready to serve.** In 2020, COVID disrupted long standing workflows and forced a sudden shift to insecure mail ballots and unmonitored dropboxes. Countless security standards, ranging from machine certification, to ballot authentication, to chain of custody documents, were abandoned. That will not happen in 2024. Americans, from election workers to election attorneys, are prepared to hold the rule of law.
3. **Election laws have improved in many states.** Mail ballot excesses have been rolled back, dropboxes have been removed, foreign exposures have been limited, voters’ rights have been expanded. You may not know this because legacy media does its level best to make us all think the Uniparty is in control. They are not.

2024 will be an epic struggle. We have to get in shape, flex muscles we’ve not used in a long time, and, as once famously said by Democrat Rep. Maxine Waters, we have to “reclaim our time.” We’ve had enough. It’s the people’s time. If we continue to stand together there’s nothing we can’t accomplish.

| | | Maine's top election official -- Secretary of State Shenna Bellows -- has removed Donald Trump from the state's 2024 ballot, citing the 14th Amendment's "insurrectionist ban." I am mindful that no Secretary of State has ever deprived a presidential candidate of ballot access based on Section Three of the Fourteenth Amendment. I am also mindful, however, that no presidential candidate has ever before engaged in insurrection." **Bellows was right to remove Trump from the ballot, but make no mistake -- this took courage. MAGA extremists have responded with a torrent of hate, threats, and vitriol, and it's got to be scary to be on the receiving end of that.** [**Sign on, join us in thanking Bellows for taking this step, and let her know that we stand with her against MAGA extremists and MAGA threats.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T789c5212-6701-4aaa-8a94-8e675e2c3dfb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Hi Peter,
As 2023 comes to a close, I want to be upfront about the crucial battle we're facing here in District 20.
