Will you join me in re-committing yourself to growing our multiracial working class movement? | | | Dear Peter, As 2023 draws to a close, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on all that we’ve accomplished together in the last year. **[But before I do, I need to ask something of you first. As we prepare for a huge election year, will you help build our collective power with a donation of $10 today? Give before the new year and your gift will be matched.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUM5vobwOfJAP3q8AFTqku9y8FRdoZhUAVDoK8D_gxyPxhtpCRKXL8haloxndv79uzNqLTo8gnwwohIB7NBq-xMdOGN98fz4yAndK1xtOzNhhrbBgVuiUYdpF2rz5utEPzQzohW7pxCpjG8Mt73t-7mPPWJuIUAVOH8GkqiUfE4ry3_2c-5QxWA8Y6K_jfrJgF2gl3VEnVpDqY1bc-IGrhxtMzA0epTflwZusq_jUn6ABnL2PEtJc3MwYgdxxi5k3UO-KgOEkGAorKqYs7sBzUsA2iB3c3CFPIUrPUf4d-Ph-xwW_AlmpLiZgby-EOax8XLJTOhUcIaSJpBBYFMlBddA/42j/TqTz41EzSoifjGD67txx0w/h0/nIkqoRyn4-P58YT5kK3e2TMQuNazEX-CiWWzLKW0iqM)** While most of the media started obsessing about the 2024 race at the beginning of this year, at the Working Families Party, we know that there’s no such thing as an “off year.” Over the last year, we’ve demonstrated our commitment to governing power and our ability to advance it, with tangible results: In **Chicago,** we teamed up with our comrades at United Working Families and a coalition of progressives to back Brandon Johnson in the mayoral primary. Five years ago, Brandon was a teacher and a union organizer. Today, thanks in part to the hard work and organizing of our diverse coalition, Brandon Johnson is the mayor of the third largest city in America. In **Philadelphia,** after electing Kendra Brooks as the first third party candidate in a generation, we wagered that if given an option, voters in an overwhelmingly Democratic city would prefer the Working Families Party over the Republican Party. So we ran a massive organizing and fundraising campaign. And on Election Day, we learned that bet paid off when we sent Kendra back to the city council and elected Nicolas O’Rourke. There are now no more Republicans holding at-large seats in Philadelphia. In **Virginia,** we helped flip the House from Republican control and kept the Democratic majority in the state Senate, putting a stop to Gov. Glenn Youngkin’s entire right-wing, anti-abortion agenda. In **Ohio,** we threw down and helped push Issue 1 — the state constitutional amendment protecting the fundamental right to an abortion. In **Pennsylvania,** climate champion Sara Innamorato toppled the party machine and became the first woman to be elected as Allegheny County Executive. Dan McCaffery was also elected to the PA Supreme Court, bolstering the pro-democracy majority ahead of the 2024 presidential election. In **New York,** many of our hundreds of endorsed candidates won across the state including new mayors in New Rochelle and Ithaca and former WFP staffer Maurice Brown was elected to the Onondaga County Legislature. We also re-elected our entire slate to the NYC City Council, with more than a quarter of votes coming on the WFP ballot line in some council districts. And we won more victories for WFP candidates in **Georgia, Colorado, New Jersey, California, North Carolina, Arizona, Washington, Texas, New Mexico,** and more. There’s no question we are on our way. There are some things about the 2024 elections that are beyond our control. But the pieces we can control are that much more critical. The Republican Party of today is so much more a threat to all of our families and to global democracy itself than it was as recently as 2016. And if by some political miracle, Donald Trump isn’t on the ballot in November, the GOP will be no less dangerous, as the institution has explicitly declared that they want to move us towards authoritarianism. Given that democracy — and our lives are on the ballot — we must do all that we can in 2024 to elect working class champions at every level of government. **At WFP, we have a bold agenda for next year: from doing our part to end Republican control of Congress, defend and elect working families champions, win in the states, and block the authoritarian right.** But as always, none of this is possible without _all_ of us. It will take a mighty coalition, coming together across our differences, to build governing power for working people of all races. **[Will you join me in re-committing yourself to growing our multiracial working class movement for the long haul with an end-of-year donation of $10 or more today? If you donate before the end of the year, your donation will be matched to go twice as far.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUM5vobwOfJAP3q8AFTqku9y8FRdoZhUAVDoK8D_gxyPxhtpCRKXL8haloxndv79uz_HrRlVEzH32fYOOqAJJ_s0zmh3idATLDv9--a1aflZkciiOFmH0kwv3TB-vrl0aB95tIPQP4KWWt7zoJNowhd2OwswZQZXsHWyOrCIzJywmRoHUwkzfU1z9sc7iqZA6KNpTrQ1XtOfzYcYCcNmBoODRbEdfHhnGF5AscTtEBkKrwRMbb-H-LtJyVivpfblMd7FGYPkxwPiYFT3RJn3aqIXpLtW8sIICWveQPGc-KGprA02FjGRacNVcN8viU8AgzO1MgUNLKvfwqbUU4YE-Izg/42j/TqTz41EzSoifjGD67txx0w/h1/4_KrjWTcpGOHn_havB3hnezXcZ9-fkExZ_kcXvRCliw)** With love and solidarity, Maurice Mitchell [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/mRshnjzLbfRUAJcmEcvG0z7LbPfEzyUQoTxoFfOCLCVbR0YoP-dpRE5F5UEI-u5cw74yFuV60nh49ZzXkTFshL9kWBkfQl8TXqjPEqADVglGtLe_vEuHWn6XXqIBbYWZtfSSbPA0YiJqgAyu3hASBTWfEtqd8--VJfZBLfpSHa9O5-3ZkV6kFCOJDUlqSwKhN5ZKKtlEuOWAgqeTwD5G21cDQfjp009zHnvvOQk2qzx2rebVw7nO8CWELaWrzs5xkBpKLTGHDUAZ9kUU2bQhc6GuvcDvjDodh_oSOc2x0Io/42j/TqTz41EzSoifjGD67txx0w/h2/wwSkXivtG8yFSldgub_JEFIJhfgEcygwrkrVllSkJzY)[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhpI1kLPEGRW4KnFarPJtxfN9U9y0YeH5CaLF3DG4soQc8Z5bS7F6zVTGH9Usg4aEvtunn0Z6jEQ5RqMSXUhQhKchfHAxTsVgNtkK-ma2Kh2OCUmIznOiR_riauh5QHIS5LpnsfMENViPeK4QNXNl5z0xmtuI9E6B3C1XE7-OhDPI9ocaJITUk6nVSJs-yCxqXNX1qkLWw5T2s_mwwCLk-a25-3BhrgHG5WQ9ps04HZkiQEQAFuwH3oewbrMdWlalTqJay9-tJXc08Zk3g7y7qDg/42j/TqTz41EzSoifjGD67txx0w/h3/KNxLjOaR25YIburJDXQTohcjHyW-Jh_dkhxPlCGngrk)[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDE-osrDsyUs4KS0eRiq-k7Q-xOI-kLyL5jO9OnnCBTuKSZJ_gXaeWSb0qtmd3GOmotLp4GF1UGbKp3Ihq7irbOHdVifeEZMXtSqwergWi_AH5Z_g-rQga75bFTN914lsj0EiisiQw7vOBkkR4nKyqd4by5r_uMTW2RGKmOm1k2gNremX1_YOgWBPiIludeEp4aLN1QyOlmyKGuYdjr7iCLV6hFaynFgYgGsmdFiGtuSr5FNKbIvLnLs8QFH77KovunHU5TPlkAoX9CE_YqQT46A/42j/TqTz41EzSoifjGD67txx0w/h4/bh5ecB2Cch_Ls5D-wgqhLkMx-DUkumMpVQl5mVgiIcg) Thoughts? clean_body: Will you join me in re-committing yourself to growing our multiracial working class movement? | | | Dear Peter, As 2023 draws to a close, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on all that we’ve accomplished together in the last year. While most of the media started obsessing about the 2024 race at the beginning of this year, at the Working Families Party, we know that there’s no such thing as an “off year.” Over the last year, we’ve demonstrated our commitment to governing power and our ability to advance it, with tangible results: In Chicago, we teamed up with our comrades at United Working Families and a coalition of progressives to back Brandon Johnson in the mayoral primary. Five years ago, Brandon was a teacher and a union organizer. Today, thanks in part to the hard work and organizing of our diverse coalition, Brandon Johnson is the mayor of the third largest city in America. In Philadelphia, after electing Kendra Brooks as the first third party candidate in a generation, we wagered that if given an option, voters in an overwhelmingly Democratic city would prefer the Working Families Party over the Republican Party. So we ran a massive organizing and fundraising campaign. And on Election Day, we learned that bet paid off when we sent Kendra back to the city council and elected Nicolas O’Rourke. There are now no more Republicans holding at-large seats in Philadelphia. In Virginia, we helped flip the House from Republican control and kept the Democratic majority in the state Senate, putting a stop to Gov. Glenn Youngkin’s entire right-wing, anti-abortion agenda. In Ohio, we threw down and helped push Issue 1 — the state constitutional amendment protecting the fundamental right to an abortion. In Pennsylvania, climate champion Sara Innamorato toppled the party machine and became the first woman to be elected as Allegheny County Executive. Dan McCaffery was also elected to the PA Supreme Court, bolstering the pro-democracy majority ahead of the 2024 presidential election. In New York, many of our hundreds of endorsed candidates won across the state including new mayors in New Rochelle and Ithaca and former WFP staffer Maurice Brown was elected to the Onondaga County Legislature. We also re-elected our entire slate to the NYC City Council, with more than a quarter of votes coming on the WFP ballot line in some council districts. And we won more victories for WFP candidates in Georgia, Colorado, New Jersey, California, North Carolina, Arizona, Washington, Texas, New Mexico, and more. There’s no question we are on our way. There are some things about the 2024 elections that are beyond our control. But the pieces we can control are that much more critical. The Republican Party of today is so much more a threat to all of our families and to global democracy itself than it was as recently as 2016. And if by some political miracle, Donald Trump isn’t on the ballot in November, the GOP will be no less dangerous, as the institution has explicitly declared that they want to move us towards authoritarianism. Given that democracy — and our lives are on the ballot — we must do all that we can in 2024 to elect working class champions at every level of government. At WFP, we have a bold agenda for next year: from doing our part to end Republican control of Congress, defend and elect working families champions, win in the states, and block the authoritarian right. But as always, none of this is possible without all of us. It will take a mighty coalition, coming together across our differences, to build governing power for working people of all races. With love and solidarity, Maurice Mitchell Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

subject: Lauren Boebert switched to run in my district
body:
My friend and fellow veteran Jerrad told me I should reach out.
| | | |
Friend,
This is Ike McCorkle, Marine Corps veteran and Democrat running in Colorado's Fourth congressional district. My friend and fellow veteran Jerrad told me I should reach out.
Jerrad and I are both former servicemembers, and each of us are running in rural and suburban districts that tend to support Democrats who have served in the armed forces. Our approach to politics and winning our campaigns reflects our shared experience in the military: be respectful, be direct and honest, and show up and work harder than everyone else.
Jerrad and I are both also running against some very dangerous Republicans who put Trump above country, and above democracy and the rule of law.
That is why I am writing to you today with some urgent news: Lauren Boebert just announced that she will abandon her district and run against me in a last-ditch attempt to save her failing campaign.
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012wJBnzNwP_E95rKCt5JJG3NEPMpuEFlXQ81IdD0yX4_6G_KEvzpFc9zeMA_rlhrAua5cBQybuW0WzRYps3g9-nw8jDVIi-GEWLfjucmXsMaVtqFEkhh2jkTA8b_mUQSfHewsd6t_kpwYcp90fp4KKnxulugbBLqjPvNOJMw1L9cVeHMH904L0BlC1J1a7F_X&c=pezg2JlunRKYfH0SrozQe35lB6LWWqovVIjcYf-lmzMqeuCUDMnzBg==&ch=uq5Vm8KWakyyazMiSXb7UdNo02CtrWcvFrofh0xlxUJHgt772fy-jg==)

body:
May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4088b6ea15e4e8190c956d3533294e9&_e=sXnDPnS9T8P_lzO1gZvrXrnrMNCZQv0sFS_eRta4qyJoE1yvPNpWredFePm58MSjAlcdX7RtmkB21xb_HPkfzSD9VNZd2XllVqx7vgsdImYsuQCintLL7XdD4kTeHOQPLiknr9i6ViYpYeghkMiIVvjEtA3L4GEjpUWOyDSzUUy2sYuE0S6BP2LYfQ6CsBn180TBOXnZRcYygMxd183RrDF3obAbhyGcnbfsMeBunVPvq8vvmipt99dhr7jh3fIPzJKw1puisX7wCONS9n8etqY5w-GW9zwRC5mnfva6wjTKQOa0gr8O0_C-YctlSHjJT2zPOig68e-TNN12ICUPkZXkOc3QS9sRda_eRUqGWWvgyVzSTzDUQnLdX14OFHLz5fcGouxNM7MhPLBqyFkoNjV_9kEoNDSJHR8QKCI-nK9nYkKMXieJvbt8zXr-iiHt)

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative. Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4088b6ea15e4e8190c956d3533294e9&_e=sXnDPnS9T8P_lzO1gZvrXrnrMNCZQv0sFS_eRta4qyJoE1yvPNpWredFePm58MSjAlcdX7RtmkB21xb_HPkfzSD9VNZd2XllVqx7vgsdImYsuQCintLL7XdD4kTeHOQPLiknr9i6ViYpYeghkMiIVvjEtA3L4GEjpUWOyDSzUUy2sYuE0S6BP2LYfQ6CsBn180TBOXnZRcYygMxd183RrDF3obAbhyGcnbfsMeBunVPvq8vvmipt99dhr7jh3fIPzJKw1puisX7wCONS9n8etqOLvO-eRJb8PQ5GFH6-De-J4CylHrO0gVXGeelN4RkxO6A0VjzrXWFpa797Jr-y207ZRv0bC2PIKQVA2AjvttJkgIiDmXO3K56X2pzmujmjeb7PIYnIEsObDSiouUTCzDpxzONDceTjoVI6obxhwhwjNksjs1b2Ls4bL-7TdhC9)

They are interfering with our democratic process and fomenting violence.

[We know there could be no algorithmic programming error, and no way for third party unauthorized actors to hack into an election system if we used hand counts. So why would democrats fight so hard to prevent hand counts? I will let you answer that yourself](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-10-16-13-1462e71a3d-8ge28941c8).

In Liberty,

Dr. Paul Gosar [](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-10-16-13-1462e71a3d-8ge28941c8) **For Freedom,**

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** | Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I hope you'll read this entire message, then consider making a donation before our end-of-year deadline to help us improve lives in CA-27 and beyond.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76039695/446475403/-233825198?refcode=em-12.29.23-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzhkMjkxMy03NGE2LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BwxH-L_ek8UBfEBQjkHYcShQLDBoaDWdUGfcu5itQjg=)**

When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76039698/446475406/-233825198?refcode=em-12.29.23-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzhkMjkxMy03NGE2LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BwxH-L_ek8UBfEBQjkHYcShQLDBoaDWdUGfcu5itQjg=)
I'll never forget the day six years ago when Maya came home from kindergarten and told me about some “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn't quite understand what was going on, but I realized she was describing an active shooter drill.

It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last.

I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on _Roe v. Wade_. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable.

**The problem we face is that a major political party in our country is not willing to take common sense steps to save lives. The good news is we have the power to change that; if we can change who represents us in Congress.**

My Republican opponent Mike Garcia co-sponsored a bill that would create a nationwide ban on abortion _without exceptions_. Literally days after the mass shooting in Uvalde, Texas, Garcia was taking cash from a pro-gun group that opposes background checks.

My campaign to unseat Mike Garcia is one of the most important races in taking Congress back from extremists. Republicans hold a slim majority and **CA-27 is one of the most competitive toss-up districts in the entire country.**

**[If you're with me, help my campaign finish strong this year and hit our fundraising goal by sending in a contribution of $5, $35, $50, whatever amount you can, to flip CA-27 and bring some common sense back to Washington.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76039702/446475408/-233825198?refcode=em-12.29.23-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzhkMjkxMy03NGE2LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BwxH-L_ek8UBfEBQjkHYcShQLDBoaDWdUGfcu5itQjg=)**

clean_body: | = Peter, = When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya. = I'll never forget the day six years ago when Maya came home from kindergarten and told me about some “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn't quite understand what was going on, but I realized she was describing an active shooter drill. It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last. I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on Roe v. Wade. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable. The problem we face is that a major political party in our country is not willing to take common sense steps to save lives. The good news is we have the power to change that; if we can change who represents us in Congress. My Republican opponent Mike Garcia co-sponsored a bill that would create a nationwide ban on abortion without exceptions. Literally days after the mass shooting in Uvalde, Texas, Garcia was taking cash from a pro-gun group that opposes background checks. My campaign to unseat Mike Garcia is one of the most important races in taking Congress back from extremists. | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

It’s the end of the year. Time for parties. New Year’s resolutions. Reflections on the past. And, of course, all those annoying political fundraising emails.

Look, I don’t like asking for money either. But I need it to run my campaign. So, I’ll just cut to the chase. [**Will you please consider making a year-end donation?**](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=5af65e4162&e=1090c5c412)

I’m not a career politician and I’m not running a traditional campaign. I’m staying positive and doing my best to avoid the polarizing rhetoric that characterizes most modern politics. If you’ve been reading my newsletters, I hope you see the difference.

But if I’m going to be different, I also need to get results.******[I need to raise enough money to win.](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=6075ee143c&e=1090c5c412)**

Many people don’t realize that federal candidates like me must raise our own campaign funds. We use the money to pay for our website, phone bills, postage, printed materials, signs, office supplies, staff support, accountants, and campaign events. Almost everything else goes to communicate our message directly to voters.

If you’ve already donated to my campaign, thank you for your ongoing support.

If not, **would you please offer[$5](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=02a738a3ba&e=1090c5c412), [$10](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=ec41ccd71a&e=1090c5c412), or [more](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=3274432d75&e=1090c5c412)?** If everyone who receives this email would donate **[$25](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=fcda8bd6ca&e=1090c5c412)** , I would have all the money I need for the rest of the primary campaign. Then I could focus exclusively on my plans for safe communities, good jobs, and strong families.

I’m working hard to change the direction of our country and preserve our way of life. **[Would you please make a year-end contribution to boost my campaign?](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=f3a38fc310&e=1090c5c412)**

subject: My radical agenda
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This is one way to show everyone we’re fighting against how many people DO believe in our plans.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1874%2E4032634%2E5K1kIk)
---
I’ll cut to the chase: [**I’m asking if you can please pitch in to support my re-election campaign so I can keep fighting for working families in the Senate.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1058?t=8&akid=1874%2E4032634%2E5K1kIk) We’re up against powerful special interests who want to see our momentum fizzle out — and your support before the December 31 FEC fundraising deadline can help mitigate their threats. After our fundraising report is published, everyone we’re fighting against will take a look at our numbers to answer some questions: “Do those radical plans of hers actually have support? Do people really believe in those ideas?” As a reminder, here are some of those “radical” plans and ideas that we’re fighting for:
* MAGA extremists shouldn't be able to stop people from voting or overturn election results they don't like.
* Multi-millionaires and billionaires should pay a small wealth tax on fortunes greater than $50 million so all of our kids can have a fighting chance at success.
* Supreme Court justices should follow a basic code of ethics to start restoring public trust in our nation’s highest court. Oh, and we should expand the Court too to rebalance it since it’s been hijacked by right-wing extremists.
* Quality child care should not eat up an entire paycheck.
* Big bank executives should not be able to gamble with consumers’ livelihoods.
* The filibuster must be abolished so we can pass the laws that the majority of Americans are calling for, like protecting abortion rights and enacting gun safety laws.

The special interests and right-wing extremists who have the most to lose from this agenda are hoping to see it have less and less public support. And publishing a strong FEC fundraising report — with a large amount of small-dollar donations — helps ensure they don’t get that satisfaction. A contribution of $28 or any amount you can give right now sends a message to those special interests and out-of-touch ideologues that you’re still in this fight — and that together, we are going to defeat them. Any sign of weakness or decline of support could signal that the momentum behind these plans is weakening — enabling our opponents to strike back, or potentially encouraging them to recruit a challenger against me to try to put our ideas to an end for good. [**So I’m relying on grassroots support to help show them how many people DO believe in the plans that we’re fighting for. And, your donation will help ensure we can advocate and grow momentum for these plans from the halls of the Senate and all across the country. So could you please pitch in $28 or anything you can before Sunday’s critical FEC fundraising deadline? Thank you.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1058?amount=28&t=9&akid=1874%2E4032634%2E5K1kIk)

Please read the following message from our sponsor.

You've been told over and over in
the media that foods like oatmeal and quinoa are good for you,
and you should eat lots of them. But what most people don't
realize is that these two particular foods contain compounds that
can actually harm your health and your digestion in many ways...

And as your favorite
Nutritionist, I'll explain why in this quick email, so you can
avoid further harming your health and digestion with these
so-called "healthy" foods...

1. Oatmeal and Oat Milk

While oatmeal is touted as a
healthy carb and a source of fiber, unfortunately there are more
cons than pros with this food...

The first problem with oats is
that they are loaded with a compound called phytic acid
(phytates) that significantly lowers your absorption of certain
minerals and vitamins, such as calcium, magnesium, and zinc.

So whenever you eat oats, the
phytic acid causes you to absorb less of these vitally important
minerals which could cause health problems if you eat oats too
frequently, since most people already don't get enough minerals
like magnesium and zinc.

The second problem with oats is
that they contain one of the highest residue concentrations of
the toxic herbicide glyphosate, which can damage your gut, and
have been linked to other health problems like cancer, hormone
issues, and more.

The next major problem with oats
is that they are a significant source of mycotoxins in the diet,
which are mold based toxins that can cause an array of gut
problems, hormone problems and more.

Lastly, oats can also contain
high levels of the toxic heavy metal Cadmium, which is linked to
health problems as this toxic heavy metal accumulates in your
body.

2. Quinoa

Quinoa is another food that is
pitched as a health food or a "superfood". Unfortunately, this
is another example of a food that has more downsides than good
sides.

First off, quinoa is high in
compounds called saponins, that have been shown in some studies
to cause gut damage and contribute to "leaky gut".

Another problematic compound in
quinoa are lectins, which are a type of antinutrient that can
damage the cells of your intestines, and contribute to several
gut disorders and immune system problems.

Many friends and colleagues of
mine have reported feeling abdominal pain after eating quinoa,
bloating, and loose stools or diarrhea, as well as triggering of
autoimmune conditions such as skin conditions.

Now that we've talked about why
we should avoid oatmeal and quinoa if we want to avoid many of
these health issues, let's look below at a unique way to HEAL
your gut, get rid of gas and bloating, increase energy, and lose
fat easier...

Bananas vs oranges vs apples...
(the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones. Both sapping you of energy and forcing
your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned
off" with normal diet and exercise.

body:
I’ve now secured the endorsement of every county GOP in the 2nd Congressional District and of the California Republican Party.

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzI6quWFwyGJlUGLt2dSjv_PFby72weOCJm6vQiZzQzWy2N-TKJCJRPXorT2jOymwTM&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=major_endorsements_entering_20&n=1)
---
---
Dear Friend, With 2024 just a few days away, I’d like to share with you a final update on our progress in 2023. I’ve now secured the endorsement of every county GOP in the 2nd Congressional District and of the California Republican Party. These endorsements, coupled with the support of organizations and individuals such as the Sonoma County Farm Bureau and Harmeet Dhillon, provide a unified front as we prepare to take on the longtime incumbent. I had the honor of speaking at the Sonoma County GOP’s annual Christmas party. I said to my fellow Republicans in the crowd that in my many conversations with constituents up and down the coast, it’s evident that many independents and even Democrats are ready for a change. Californians who haven’t voted Republican for 20+ years, or ever, are ready to give our party a chance again. They are willing to entrust leadership to someone who speaks honestly about our district’s decline but pragmatically about its potential. We can again have great schools, plentiful jobs, safe neighborhoods, and clean, plentiful water. These blessings flow from good policies at the federal, state, and local levels. Our decades-long decline, overseen by the incumbent and his party, will not be fixed in 1 year or 1 term. But it must begin in 2024. Next year, the Democratic Party will realize they can no longer take our district for granted. **[But I need to ask for your continued support so that we can enter 2024 in a position of financial strength. Can you contribute to my campaign before the Dec. 31 reporting deadline?](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzI6quWFwyGJlUGLt2dSjv_PFby72weOCJm6vQiZzQzWy2N-TKJCJRPXorT2jOymwTM&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=major_endorsements_entering_20&n=2)** Ballots will be mailed out in just a few weeks, and we have work to do, including door-knocking, phone calls, and advertisements. Our challenge will be to contact hundreds of thousands of voters up and down the coast — Republicans, moderate Democrats, and independents — to ensure they have the information they need to make an informed decision. **[These final 2 months of our primary campaign will be expensive. Any amount that you can chip in before the new year will go a long way.](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzI6quWFwyGJlUGLt2dSjv_PFby72weOCJm6vQiZzQzWy2N-TKJCJRPXorT2jOymwTM&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=major_endorsements_entering_20&n=3)** Thank you for standing with me. Your support of our shared mission makes it all possible. Semper Fidelis, **Chris Coulombe** Republican Candidate for California’s 2nd Congressional District **[P.S. Our fight is against a well-funded incumbent backed by the Democrat Party’s machinery. Every contribution you make helps our message reach more voters in California’s 2nd Congressional District. clean_body: I’ve now secured the endorsement of every county GOP in the 2nd Congressional District and of the California Republican Party. | | | Dear Friend, With 2024 just a few days away, I’d like to share with you a final update on our progress in 2023. I’ve now secured the endorsement of every county GOP in the 2nd Congressional District and of the California Republican Party. These endorsements, coupled with the support of organizations and individuals such as the Sonoma County Farm Bureau and Harmeet Dhillon, provide a unified front as we prepare to take on the longtime incumbent. I had the honor of speaking at the Sonoma County GOP’s annual Christmas party. I said to my fellow Republicans in the crowd that in my many conversations with constituents up and down the coast, it’s evident that many independents and even Democrats are ready for a change. Californians who haven’t voted Republican for 20+ years, or ever, are ready to give our party a chance again. They are willing to entrust leadership to someone who speaks honestly about our district’s decline but pragmatically about its potential. We can again have great schools, plentiful jobs, safe neighborhoods, and clean, plentiful water. These blessings flow from good policies at the federal, state, and local levels. Our decades-long decline, overseen by the incumbent and his party, will not be fixed in 1 year or 1 term. But it must begin in 2024. Next year, the Democratic Party will realize they can no longer take our district for granted. Ballots will be mailed out in just a few weeks, and we have work to do, including door-knocking, phone calls, and advertisements. Our challenge will be to contact hundreds of thousands of voters up and down the coast — Republicans, moderate Democrats, and independents — to ensure they have the information they need to make an informed decision. Thank you for standing with me. Your support of our shared mission makes it all possible. I’m asking you for $3. It’s not easy for me to do, since you have already done so much to support my campaign. But with our final FEC fundraising deadline of the year closing in just a few days, I really need you.

Hello Peter,
I’m writing to ask if you will make your first to our campaign before our final FEC deadline of 2023. I hope you will give me a minute to explain why this request is important — **[but if you are ready to do your part right now, you can donate at this link knowing how grateful I am for your support.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20231229-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20231229-2&refcode2=1531_552475_0vvRuS&akid=1531%2E552475%2E0vvRuS)**
The truth is, defending this Senate seat isn’t only about ensuring we can keep fighting for Pennsylvania families in Washington, as important as that is.
This is also the race that could decide if Democrats hold our Senate majority. We know that, and Mitch McConnell knows it, too.
It is hard to understate the stakes, Peter: Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, women’s rights, LGBTQIA+ equality, the right to vote, and more are on the line if Republicans flip the Senate next year.
We need to be able to fight back against the millions that McConnell and the GOP are going to spend here, which will hinge on our ability to show the strength of this campaign heading into the Election Year.

body:
a huge opportunity [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend , I need you to understand this: The path to defending our Senate majority runs directly through Florida. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
This is not an election year where we can afford to just play defense. Make no mistake, I'm not giving up on any of our Democratic seats. But after the news that Sen. Manchin is not seeking reelection, our chances of defending every single blue seat just got even slimmer.
That means flipping a red state to blue is the only option left if we want to guarantee a Democratic Senate majority in 2024. And now that polling data shows Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is already tied with Rick Scott in Florida, I need every Democrat who cares about defending our Senate majority to invest in Debbie's race right now. Please, will you donate $10 — split between Debbie and Kirsten Gillibrand — before Debbie's urgent end-of-quarter deadline to make sure that she has the resources she'll need to flip this seat blue in 2024? [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately:

Debbie is giving us a huge opportunity here in Florida, and we cannot afford to waste it, friend.
Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators in the entire country. And that's not just coming from me — the analysts at CNN, Roll Call , and FiveThirtyEight all agree. He only won this seat by 10,033 votes in 2018, and that's after he spent $64 MILLION of his own fortune.
Now, his approval ratings are underwater and Debbie's campaign is shaping up to be one of our best chances to save our majority in 2024. She has a strong record of results and a winning message that will speak to voters all across Florida. Recent polling data shows that her grassroots campaign has already made this race a statistical tie.
We've put Rick Scott on notice — but he's not going down without a fight. In the last few months alone, he's shelled out $3 million on attack ads smearing Democrats like Debbie with baseless lies. That's more than any other GOP Senate candidate so far.
This race will be one of the most expensive Senate races in the entire country. Debbie has what it takes to win, but only if she can build a grassroots warchest that's capable of taking on Scott's millions. That starts with hitting her critical $300,000 end-of-quarter goal — her FINAL goal before the election year officially begins . Time is running out to make sure that Debbie hits this goal, so please, friend, can I count on you to split a donation between her campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand? This $300,000 goal is Debbie's most important goal yet and she'll only hit it with your help. [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
Thank you,
Chuck Schumer

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I feel very confident that Vivek as President will be able to lead our country toward values that emphasize accountability, hard work, and merit. He's already proved so many D.C. insiders wrong. I hope you're with us, Apoorva Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: | Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. Derek,
I’m never one for BS.
I take a lot of pride in these emails being honest and transparent. Today, that means being honest that things aren’t looking so hot.
**Two December polls show me being pushed out of the primary. That means my time in Congress would come to an end.**
Let me explain: California has a unique system. The top two vote-getters in March’s primary advance to the general election in November. **Early polling suggests that I am in a very strong position to win the general election, but the math in this primary is weird.** A celebrity Republican is gaining traction in the polls, and he could advance to second place and keep us from qualifying for the general election.
So I have to ask: **[Can you contribute $5 today to help us run ads and reach key voters ahead of our March primary?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231229-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_NBS_20231229_V1_F&refcode2=35596_3422442_lQy94O&akid=35596%2E3422442%2ElQy94O)**

Right now is one of the most critical times for our fundraising. Soon, we’re going to start running TV and digital ads all across the state, and that means millions of dollars will be leaving our bank account. Every week. If our fundraising doesn’t pick up, we’re going to have to scale back our ads even further, and I risk being unable to catch up.
But here’s the good news: polls show that when voters learn about who I am and why I’m running, we pull ahead.**I just need your help to communicate with voters.**

**[Can you please make a donation before the end of the year?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231229-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_NBS_20231229_V1_F&refcode2=35596_3422442_lQy94O&akid=35596%2E3422442%2ElQy94O)**

Thanks a ton! Can’t do this without you.

clean_body: Palestinians deserve safety and freedom, like all humans. | | | Friend, UNICEF called Gaza “the most dangerous place in the world to be a child.” In just a month and a half, Israel’s military dropped more than 22,000 U.S.-provided bombs on a captive population in Gaza. Bombing continues to intensify, and President Biden recently bypassed Congress to send $100 million in more weapons and bombs. | Most of the 2.3 million Palestinians living in Gaza are starving, as Israel’s government prevents access to water, healthcare, and food. Hundreds of thousands of children are suffering from disease, and at least 8,000 have been murdered. President Biden could end this devastation. Instead, he’s enabling it. His administration continues to shield Israel’s government from accountability at the UN, blocking and watering down necessary action to stop the bloodshed and provide adequate aid to people in Gaza. He’s considering giving into Republicans’ demands to gut asylum and begin mass deportations of U.S. immigrants—all in order to send billions more of our tax dollars to Israel’s military as it publicly and actively commits war crimes. Palestinians and all humans deserve to be free. We all deserve dignity, and Americans deserve a government that values life and upholds human rights. We are working to create that government and that world. We will keep demanding it, together. In solidarity, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Thu, Dec 28, 2023 Subject: Sign to President Biden: Stop sending bombs to Israel’s military as it commits war crimes To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, Instead of working for a just and lasting ceasefire, President Biden and his administration have bypassed Congress in order to hand over weapons and bombs to the Israeli government—as it carries out war crimes and massacres Palestinians. The American people, including 80% of Democratic voters, are demanding a ceasefire. We’re done watching our government support cutting off food, water, electricity, and medical care to millions of people with nowhere to go. Thanks to Biden, the U.S. has vetoed and watered down UN Security Council resolutions for a ceasefire and humanitarian aid. And he’s still trying to send $14 billion of our tax dollars to Israel’s military, without any conditions on upholding human rights. One of my top priorities in Congress is protecting water as a human right. No family should ever have to go without access to something as fundamental as water—whether in my district, my family’s homeland, or anywhere. UNICEF’s Executive Director said: “Access to sufficient amounts of clean water is a matter of life and death, and children in Gaza have barely a drop to drink.” She blamed “the constant bombing, along with the restrictions on materials and fuel allowed into the territory.” Human Rights Watch just accused Israel’s government of using starvation as a weapon of war. “It doesn’t get any worse,’” said the World Food Programme’s chief economist, who noted: “I have never seen something at the scale that is happening in Gaza and at this speed.” Hundreds of thousands of children in Gaza are suffering from diseases related to malnutrition, lack of clean water, and displacement. They can’t get healthcare or medical supplies because of the bombing and the blockade. This is an intensification of the Israeli government’s years-long blockade on Gaza. In Gaza and the West Bank, Israel’s government restricts Palestinians’ access to water, electricity, and medical care. I remember going through checkpoints with my grandmother as the Israeli military interrogated and segregated her, simply for trying to seek services such as healthcare. Achieving a just and lasting peace—where Israelis and Palestinians have equal rights and freedoms, and where no person lives in fear for their safety—requires ending the blockade, occupation, and dehumanizing system of apartheid. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

This month, I stood alongside union leaders and Jewish advocates demanding
a ceasefire. The next day, dozens of staff from the Biden administration
held a vigil outside the White House, “risking their jobs and, possibly,
their careers because they know the stakes of this moment.”[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231229-2-rt.QC94kR&refcode=em20231229-32551&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=32551%2E1203867%2EzJxNo3 ]

[1]Common Dreams: Biden Staffers Demand Cease-Fire at 'Historic' White
House Vigil

It shouldn’t be controversial to say: Stop the killing! Let’s save lives!
In fact, it's what a vast majority of Americans and people around the
world are calling for, and our anti-war movement keeps growing.

But rather than work for a ceasefire or acknowledge the humanity of
Palestinians, our elected leaders are supporting more violence. Before the
House adjourned for the year, my colleagues voted to approve an $886.3
billion budget for war and destruction—the largest military budget in the
history of our country. I voted against this massively wasteful budget
that funds more bombs, weapons, and war crimes.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231229-2-rt.QC94kR&refcode=em20231229-32551&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32551%2E1203867%2EzJxNo3 ]Make a split donation to my campaign and Justice Democrats today to
keep the pressure on President Biden and Congress to join us in demanding
a ceasefire now!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231229-2-rt.QC94kR&refcode=em20231229-32551&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32551%2E1203867%2EzJxNo3 ]Contribute $3

Thank you. Together, we demand not only a ceasefire, but also an end to
the blockade on Gaza, an end to the dehumanizing system of apartheid, and
the return of all hostages and those arbitrarily detained.

In love and solidarity,

Rashida

**[Two days — which is why I’m asking you to pitch in $2 to send the guy in the picture to the U.S. Senate. I’ll explain more below.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2764?c0=dec2023_abs_em.23u8hZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20231229_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4903%2E5257348%2EUbnVj1)** [DONATE $2](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2764?c0=dec2023_abs_em.23u8hZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20231229_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=4903%2E5257348%2EUbnVj1)
---
The young guy in the photo is me as a young federal prosecutor in California.
One of the first cases I took on involved a corporation that hired toxic waste haulers to smuggle hazardous materials across the border into Mexico.
The U.S. government had just put in place additional environmental regulations to protect our drinking water and our communities. This made it harder to dump chemicals and toxic waste in the U.S. and was critical for water safety.
The corporation in the case — a laminating company — paid the haulers to smuggle the waste across the border and dump it in Mexico. We found dozens of drums of hazardous waste there, from paints to flammable solvents and other toxic materials. We also intercepted a fair amount of other cargo intended to be dumped. Tragically, people living there emptied the drums, filled them with water, and washed clothes in them, among other unknowingly dangerous uses.
**As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I took on this waste dumping corporation — and won.**
It was the first federal prosecution for across-the-border toxic waste dumping ever. **It set an important precedent: that no company, big or small, could avoid accountability when harming our planet and putting the health of communities at risk, at home or abroad.**
Back to today: Pitching in $2, or any amount you can spare, will help our campaign for the United States Senate, where I will continue to hold those big corporations polluting our planet accountable.
$2 will help me make it to the Senate to pass legislation like the Green New Deal so we can protect our precious planet, create more green jobs, and build cleaner infrastructure.

# 2023 Has Been A Year to Remember

Peter, 2023 has been a momentous year for all of us who love our country.
And today may be the most momentous day of the year for Team Majewski! We have [**HOURS**](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=c36318b527&e=0426928d91)[****](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=edac1fd887&e=0426928d91) left until the 2023 FEC-mandated end-of-year campaign finance deadline. A deadline that couldn’t be more crucial for you to pledge your support, not only to my campaign but to the America First movement that remains our only hope to bring the nation back together and restore the country that we so love!
Even as I type this, Biden and his band of tyrants have been scurrying around, pulling every string they can pull to [**REMOVE**](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=fe4fdc3774&e=0426928d91)[****](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=189cfcf585&e=0426928d91) President Trump from the ballot unconstitutionally! As I see it, there are only two paths moving forward from today!
1. Either, we cement TODAY as the day we took a stand against this tyranny...
2. Or, we allow the Left to fully transform our once-free nation into a third-world Dictatorship!

The choice is clear for me; what will it be for you? If you believe in America; if you believe in freedom; if you want peace and prosperity again, I urge you to seize [**TODAY**](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=c107ae6272&e=0426928d91)[****](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=6896e386d8&e=0426928d91) as the day you will pledge your support abolish tyranny! Will you pledge $20.24 to bring us over into the new year?
| [DONATE TO SUPPORT AMERICA FIRST](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=ae9d9e117a&e=0426928d91)
---
Of course, [**$202.40**](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=6b5f4033c0&e=0426928d91) or **$**[**2,024**](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=e659084598&e=0426928d91)[ ](https://jrforohio.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f8b050a6338dbb74901cdea58&id=079cbfe7e2&e=0426928d91)would give us an extra edge to fight back against the villains of our society, a.k.a. Joe Biden, Marcy Kaptur, and their gang of crooks. Whatever you decide, I urge you to take action right NOW. We cannot delay or we risk being outplayed! Your generosity can make all the difference today in 2024.

| Peter,

I know you’re probably receiving a ton of emails this week, but I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read this one.

Peter, I really hate asking for even a dollar of your money, but the reality is that fundraising is the price I have to pay to continue serving as a member of the House of Representatives.

**My seat is on the ballot every two years – which means I’m almost constantly running for re-election. So I know it seems like I’m always asking for money, but with a race as competitive as this one, we have to always be prepared.**

As someone who doesn't take corporate PAC money, the contributions from folks like you are key to my successful campaigns. In 2022, my House race was the most expensive in the state because dark money groups were flooding our district with outside funds.

Since we’re running in a toss-up district again this cycle, we need to ensure we have the resources necessary to fend off outside attacks. | | Peter, I’ll cut right to the chase- the radical Left just called me one of Hillary Clinton’s “basket of deplorables” and said that I’m “not morally fit for office.”

It’s as if Tim Kaine and his friends have learned absolutely nothing, Peter.

The Left paints anyone they see as even somewhat conservative as a subhuman moral pariah.

They turn their noses up at us from their hoity-toity ivory towers and call us “deplorable” because we’re daring to do things differently.

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

clean_body: | = Hey there, friend — I hope you and your loved ones are enjoying the holiday season. We’re nearing the end of the year (can you believe it?!) and our team is working hard to prepare for 2024. Recently I had the opportunity to join Dems in Yuma at the Somerton Tamale Festival and in Coconino for their Winter Party, and was filled with the energy I felt across the state. = = County by county, community by community, folks are ready to elect Democrats up and down the ballot who are fighting for good-paying, green infrastructure jobs, ensuring our schools prepare every student for success, and who are fighting against the extremism on the right that’s hurting Arizonans. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your recurring contribution will go through immediately: | = = = All the reports I’ve seen are showing that 2024 could be one of the most expensive election cycles to date. Republicans and their dark money donors have already raised MILLIONS of dollars to flood battleground states like Arizona with a strategy to keep control of the House and put Donald Trump back in the White House. This past year, Democrats have accomplished so much to help working families across Arizona. Bidenomics is saving Arizonans billions on energy expenses, bringing back good-paying, clean energy, union jobs that are helping families keep food on the table and lowering the price of prescriptions. No matter if I’m in Tucson or talking to voters out in Kayenta, everyone’s fired up and ready to re-elect President Biden and continue building on the agenda that works for working families. Our team is committed to mobilizing every community and continuing to move Arizona forward. = Thank you friend, — Yolanda Bejarano, Chair = Arizona Democratic Party PO Box 36123 Phoenix, AZ 85067-6123 United States mailto:info@azdem.org | Paid for by Arizona Democrats

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Looking Back on 2023, and Looking Ahead to 2024
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
As we get ready to ring in the New Year, I am thinking about all we achieved together this year.
I started the year by returning to Congress for my third term and we began to build our 2024 re-election campaign. I’ve worked on important legislation in Congress, stood firm against House Republicans’ agenda when it’s at odds with our values and priorities, and spoken to Texans about their concerns and hopes for the future.
I was able to talk to people about the critical work we have done for our community and our country this year. I’m glad to share some highlights of the year below. One of the biggest highlights has been the generous support in response to emails like this one, asking for support. (And you can do that again here, of course!) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
JANUARY
I began my third term in Congress and became the Whip of the Pro-Choice Caucus. I took on this new role at an important time, in time to join Vice President Kamala Harris in marking the first anniversary of Roe v. Wade since the Supreme Court overturned the decision. Here in Texas, we see firsthand the grave threats to our reproductive health care and to our freedom. (More on that a little later in this email.) It’s so important for me to bring this Texas perspective to Congress.
FEBRUARY
I became Vice Chair of the Equality Caucus, leading efforts in Congress to advance equality, combat discrimination, and improve opportunities and access for our LGBTQI+ community. Unfortunately, this role came at a critical time as well, as I spent the year fighting House Republicans’ anti-LGBTQI+ policies, including bills that would make schools hostile environments for LGBTQI+ students.
MARCH
In March, I was named the Chair of the New Democrat Coalition’s Trade Task Force, an issue of critical importance to people in my internationally focused district, and for people across the country. And I had the joy of welcoming the United States Trade Representative Ambassador Katherine Tai to Houston for the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo.
APRIL
A federal court in Texas issued an unprecedented decision staying the Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA’s) approval of medication for the termination of pregnancy, which accounts for more than half of abortions performed in the United States today. This legal battle is still ongoing as this month the Supreme Court announced it will hear the case and decide the future of abortion medication in our country. I introduced a bill that would reaffirm the FDA’s authority to approve safe medications, including the abortion pill.
MAY
My friend and colleague Colin Allred launched his campaign for U.S. Senate. I was thrilled to welcome him to Houston for his launch, and to work with him every step of the way for the rest of the year as he’s built a strong, impressive campaign. I’m looking forward to working with him in 2024 to give Texans the leadership they need and deserve.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
JUNE
Our Democracy Summer interns joined #TeamLizzie for their fellowships! The Democracy Summer project seeks to bring about political change in America by training and deploying the next generation of Democratic organizers and leaders to win elections at every level. This one-of-a-kind Democratic Fellowship—founded by my friend Congressman Jamie Raskin—is now undertaken across the country to teach high school and college students state-of-the-art tactics in voter registration and political organizing, the dynamic history of political and social change in our country, and essential lessons for political leadership.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
Our Democracy Summer interns hard at work!
JULY
We saw the extremism of the current House majority in its version of the annual defense bill, the National Defense Authorization Act , after Republicans turned it into a deeply partisan bill with extreme amendments, including one that would reverse a Department of Defense policy that helps service members stationed in states where abortion is illegal—like Texas—to travel to get the reproductive care they need. This was a stark reminder of how important it is for Democrats to take back the House in 2024.
AUGUST
I welcomed Colin Allred back to Houston as part of his Texas Listening Tour. I loved introducing him to our awesome community leaders, including members of the labor community and Harris County Democrats.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
Me & Colin Allred at his listening tour in Houston.
SEPTEMBER
House Republicans pushed us to the brink of a government shutdown, arguing with each other over drastic cuts and divisive policies instead of working with Democrats to avoid a shutdown that would hurt Americans, our economy, and our national security. After finally coming to a resolution, Republicans ousted Kevin McCarthy as Speaker and spent weeks picking his replacement, bringing the House to a halt.
OCTOBER
Our campaign team celebrated a big milestone: We brought in 700 contributions through our digital program! Those are 700 powerful contributions that will be put to work to build our campaign and win our #TX07 race next year.
NOVEMBER
I filed paperwork for re-election, officially putting my name on the ballot for 2024.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
Me & #TeamLizzie on the day I filed paperwork to appear on the ballot in 2024.
DECEMBER
A Texas woman carrying a nonviable pregnancy that threatened her health and future fertility was forced to leave the state to get abortion care after the state Supreme Court blocked a ruling allowing her to get the care she needed. Unfortunately, even the right to travel for reproductive care is at risk, which is why, earlier this year, I reintroduced my bill that would protect that right. House Democrats passed the bill when we were in charge, and we will again when we take back the House.
This year has reminded us how important our work together is. It is a team effort, and I could not be more grateful for what you've done. The next year will bring challenges and opportunities, with important elections up and down the ballot, in Texas and across the country. I remain committed to working together whenever we can and to standing up and fighting back for our communities and our country when we must. At the same time, we’re working to bring home another win for TX-07 next year and help elect Democrats up and down the ballot in this important presidential election year.
You have an important role to play in that work. One way you can help us get off to a great start in 2024 is by contributing before tomorrow’s end-of-year FEC deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231229?refcode=lpfe231229]
Together, we can do anything,

FEBRUARY I became Vice Chair of the Equality Caucus, leading efforts in Congress to advance equality, combat discrimination, and improve opportunities and access for our LGBTQI+ community. Unfortunately, this role came at a critical time as well, as I spent the year fighting House Republicans’ anti-LGBTQI+ policies, including bills that would make schools hostile environments for LGBTQI+ students. MARCH In March, I was named the Chair of the New Democrat Coalition’s Trade Task Force, an issue of critical importance to people in my internationally focused district, and for people across the country. And I had the joy of welcoming the United States Trade Representative Ambassador Katherine Tai to Houston for the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo. APRIL A federal court in Texas issued an unprecedented decision staying the Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA’s) approval of medication for the termination of pregnancy, which accounts for more than half of abortions performed in the United States today. This legal battle is still ongoing as this month the Supreme Court announced it will hear the case and decide the future of abortion medication in our country. I introduced a bill that would reaffirm the FDA’s authority to approve safe medications, including the abortion pill. MAY My friend and colleague Colin Allred launched his campaign for U.S. Senate. I was thrilled to welcome him to Houston for his launch, and to work with him every step of the way for the rest of the year as he’s built a strong, impressive campaign. I’m looking forward to working with him in 2024 to give Texans the leadership they need and deserve. [] JUNE Our Democracy Summer interns joined #TeamLizzie for their fellowships! The Democracy Summer project seeks to bring about political change in America by training and deploying the next generation of Democratic organizers and leaders to win elections at every level. This one-of-a-kind Democratic Fellowship—founded by my friend Congressman Jamie Raskin—is now undertaken across the country to teach high school and college students state-of-the-art tactics in voter registration and political organizing, the dynamic history of political and social change in our country, and essential lessons for political leadership. [] Our Democracy Summer interns hard at work! JULY We saw the extremism of the current House majority in its version of the annual defense bill, the National Defense Authorization Act , after Republicans turned it into a deeply partisan bill with extreme amendments, including one that would reverse a Department of Defense policy that helps service members stationed in states where abortion is illegal—like Texas—to travel to get the reproductive care they need. This was a stark reminder of how important it is for Democrats to take back the House in 2024. AUGUST I welcomed Colin Allred back to Houston as part of his Texas Listening Tour. I loved introducing him to our awesome community leaders, including members of the labor community and Harris County Democrats. [] Me & Colin Allred at his listening tour in Houston. SEPTEMBER House Republicans pushed us to the brink of a government shutdown, arguing with each other over drastic cuts and divisive policies instead of working with Democrats to avoid a shutdown that would hurt Americans, our economy, and our national security. After finally coming to a resolution, Republicans ousted Kevin McCarthy as Speaker and spent weeks picking his replacement, bringing the House to a halt. OCTOBER Our campaign team celebrated a big milestone: We brought in 700 contributions through our digital program! Those are 700 powerful contributions that will be put to work to build our campaign and win our #TX07 race next year. NOVEMBER I filed paperwork for re-election, officially putting my name on the ballot for 2024. [] Me & #TeamLizzie on the day I filed paperwork to appear on the ballot in 2024. DECEMBER A Texas woman carrying a nonviable pregnancy that threatened her health and future fertility was forced to leave the state to get abortion care after the state Supreme Court blocked a ruling allowing her to get the care she needed. Unfortunately, even the right to travel for reproductive care is at risk, which is why, earlier this year, I reintroduced my bill that would protect that right. House Democrats passed the bill when we were in charge, and we will again when we take back the House. This year has reminded us how important our work together is. It is a team effort, and I could not be more grateful for what you've done. The next year will bring challenges and opportunities, with important elections up and down the ballot, in Texas and across the country. I remain committed to working together whenever we can and to standing up and fighting back for our communities and our country when we must. At the same time, we’re working to bring home another win for TX-07 next year and help elect Democrats up and down the ballot in this important presidential election year. You have an important role to play in that work. One way you can help us get off to a great start in 2024 is by contributing before tomorrow’s end-of-year FEC deadline. [] Together, we can do anything, [] DONATE [] PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS Lizzie Fletcher for Congress 3262 Westheimer Road, PMB 636 Houston, TX 77098 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

body:
Kari Lake is already in the race. It looks like Kyrsten Sinema might be getting ready to jump in.
#

Peter,
We send a lot of emails, and we know you can’t give to every single one in your inbox — that would be ridiculous.
But if you can, we hope you’ll chip in to this one. Please let us explain why:
**FIRST:** With Kari Lake in the race, receiving support from Trump, the MAGA-right, and the establishment in DC, we’ve already got our hands full.
**THEN:** We keep hearing talk that Senator Kyrsten Sinema is getting closer and closer to running. She hasn’t slowed down her fundraising, and she was one of the top spenders on digital ads in the entire country last week.
**NOW:** If Senator Sinema really is running, we have to be ready for it. And with our final FEC fundraising deadline of the year approaching in just TWO DAYS, the timing could not be worse.
Who knows what 2024 will bring. But if everyone reading this email right now contributed just $10, we’d reach our goals today. We’d have the resources we need to win this race.
That’s the problem though: Not everyone gives. That’s why it’s so important that folks like you do — people who know the stakes, who know how important this Senate race is, who understand how important these donations are to victory.
Can we count on you?

_A young Raul Ruiz in Kindergarten, reciting the pledge of allegiance._ **Folks, when I was a kid, I loved to read.

I would read anything I could get my hands on.** Adventure books, comic books, cereal boxes, you name it. As I grew up, I read books that broadened my view of the world, challenged my ideas, and forced me to grow as a person.

I am, in part, the person I am today because of the experiences I gained while reading. I’m more empathetic, more understanding, and more willing to hear someone else’s point of view.

Which is why it terrifies me to see extreme MAGA Republicans all across the country (even in California!) pushing to ban books with just a passing mention of complicated topics or ideas that MAGA extremists find taboo.

Put plainly, team – these MAGA book bans are blatant attacks, not only on the free expression of authors and school children, but adults and society more broadly.

I’m fighting tooth-and-nail against ever increasing MAGA book bans, but we need to snuff out this bigoted movement where it starts –**with the MAGA politicians that fuel the hate and fervor of these movements.**

[**Our best chance to fight back against the extreme MAGA agenda is at the ballot box. | Peter ... the OC Register just wrote an important story (below!) about young candidates like **Max Ukropina** challenging the status quo in Orange County.

They're picking up on what we've known since we started this campaign, Peter - voters are ready for _**a new generation of leaders.**_ They're tired of the same career politicians who have been around for decades and keep failing us.

**We're going to win this primary because Max Ukropina is running to bring NEW America First, conservative leadership back to California's 47th District!**

| _That’s a sentiment shared by Republican Max Ukropina, a 36-year-old congressional candidate from Costa Mesa. Younger people, Ukropina said, “can’t wait (to run for office) until things have become even worse.” _ ... _Ukropina, who like Hunt is trying to flip a House seat, said younger people are becoming increasingly important in elections, especially in districts where there are large communities of them._

_The median age of the 47th congressional district, where Ukropina is running, is 38.5, according to census data. Additionally, people aged 25 to 44 account for roughly 30% of the district’s total population, making them the largest demographic in that district._ ... _Ukropina said he’s heard from fellow young Republicans who are most concerned about border security and safety in their communities as well as the cost of living in Orange County._

_Nationwide, voters under the age of 30 cite the economy as the biggest issue the country faces, according to a recent Emerson College poll._

_Ukropina decried Congress’ decision to temporarily suspend the maximum amount of debt the U.S. is allowed to accrue until Jan. 1, 2025, saying it’s a disservice to Americans._

_“It’s just crazy to me that we have a Congress that is willing to saddle more debt onto the younger generations,” he said. _
