clean_body: They're picking up on what we already know... | | | | Peter ... the OC Register just wrote an important story (below!) about young candidates like Max Ukropina challenging the status quo in Orange County. They're picking up on what we've known since we started this campaign, Peter - voters are ready for a new generation of leaders. They're tired of the same career politicians who have been around for decades and keep failing us. We're going to win this primary because Max Ukropina is running to bring NEW America First, conservative leadership back to California's 47th District! | "HELP SEND MAX TO CONGRESS" | Click the headline below to read the full story at OCRegister.com or check out key excerpts below! | | That’s a sentiment shared by Republican Max Ukropina, a 36-year-old congressional candidate from Costa Mesa. Younger people, Ukropina said, “can’t wait (to run for office) until things have become even worse.” ... Ukropina, who like Hunt is trying to flip a House seat, said younger people are becoming increasingly important in elections, especially in districts where there are large communities of them. The median age of the 47th congressional district, where Ukropina is running, is 38.5, according to census data. Additionally, people aged 25 to 44 account for roughly 30% of the district’s total population, making them the largest demographic in that district. ... Ukropina said he’s heard from fellow young Republicans who are most concerned about border security and safety in their communities as well as the cost of living in Orange County. Nationwide, voters under the age of 30 cite the economy as the biggest issue the country faces, according to a recent Emerson College poll. Ukropina decried Congress’ decision to temporarily suspend the maximum amount of debt the U.S. is allowed to accrue until Jan. 1, 2025, saying it’s a disservice to Americans. “It’s just crazy to me that we have a Congress that is willing to saddle more debt onto the younger generations,” he said. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2023 Max Ukropina for Congress, All rights reserved.

**“The IRS is like the Mafia. They can take anything they want!” ** **-Jerry Seinfeld** Friend, As a former FBI Special Agent, I’ve dealt with my fair share of mobsters, mafiosos, and gang bangers. I’ll tell you this from my own first hand experience: JERRY SEINFELD IS RIGHT! So when Joe Biden and his crew in Congress decided to hire 87,000 new IRS agents it didn’t sit right with me at all. **[In fact, that’s one of the reasons I’m running for U.S. Senate in Michigan.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=4130c3040d9942e0b25842da082e895c&_e=Thc8iDz4wUc-TMdEIY_s2cMhtNKaOYfaqANPrOkeTvrSr9lqFmUJ9WDdS5ZqfgFvXM6cQl7Fn8IG3M-TSMSgoro10mjeDP6aM06uMexd-G7HPNru9xm0VqZkVNkpwQOcI1rgqjfxcqxIlGkw4En50bmXHQsOvp2rDELq_eUBL9mDOkjw2-uDBj9Z7Pd0Ky_lS8lvhLyjwb6ofKseYOyVloeWtj70EvDypRhE9AHuhkFXM9D0pbOav8a5QfxTvyD0zhKMo0jpr-mWaQZnpvrxHyfuUMja4v4gns3aKzgFDrIA81zs8zxluTRjvwi2Xb1BKqP5AFth9cft5kjE80q24zAoieXAVSLHcpXABDOTSscUIwcVV8jiumiXydQCbwTkNq-Oye5w5AjYdXbwcvHMcg%3D%3D)** Friend, they PROMISED that these new IRS agents would only be coming after people making over $400,000 per year. _**[That was a LIE.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=4130c3040d9942e0b25842da082e895c&_e=Thc8iDz4wUc-TMdEIY_s2cMhtNKaOYfaqANPrOkeTvrSr9lqFmUJ9WDdS5ZqfgFvXM6cQl7Fn8IG3M-TSMSgoro10mjeDP6aM06uMexd-G7HPNru9xm0VqZkVNkpwQOcI1rgqjfxcqxIlGkw4En50bmXHQsOvp2rDELq_eUBL9mDOkjw2-uDBj9Z7Pd0Ky_lS8lvhLyjwb6ofKseYOyVloeWtj70EvDypRhE9AHuhkFXM9D0pbOav8a5QfxTvyD0-GDbkN6lE7llm3JTNUsxpGzy0h3d3oEqatZMPQ5BTDD-cq_PWxngmh_rKGlTtqy9dcukQRb_Xv-mcpxroZyKN6TBLxss8d8_gUaarsfCXxqOc6cSgPSmi_MbasvBvMgav0hQLFfkr-IHAbYDnAK2Gg%3D%3D)**_ Biden’s Treasury Secretary admitted that 90% of ALL audits conducted by the IRS would affect people making less than $400,000 per year. Instead of using more IRS personnel to help law enforcement bust money laundering operations for high income tax dodgers, human traffickers, fentanyl smugglers, and the violent drug cartels- they’re focusing their energy on monitoring your Venmo transactions. They’re coming after your teenage grandson’s neighborhood lawn care business. They’re coming after your niece’s math tutoring job. They’re coming after your neighbor’s restaurant tips. Joe Biden’s left-wing foot soldiers are coming to bully and harass anyone who dares step out of line. And what’s worse: **unlike what the mafia does, it’s all**** _legal._** Friend, Biden’s drastic expansion of the IRS adds insult to injury for those who are already reeling from his failed economic policies. **But when I’m elected, they’ll be gone. ** We can **PROTECT** American taxpayers from Biden and his left-wing friends, but **ONLY** if Republicans take back the Senate. And when we flip Michigan red, I’ll do exactly that. Friend, I know that the economy is rough right now, **[but anything you can give, whether it be $5, $10, or $20, will go a long way toward fixing this massive problem.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=4130c3040d9942e0b25842da082e895c&_e=Thc8iDz4wUc-TMdEIY_s2cMhtNKaOYfaqANPrOkeTvrSr9lqFmUJ9WDdS5ZqfgFvXM6cQl7Fn8IG3M-TSMSgoro10mjeDP6aM06uMexd-G7HPNru9xm0VqZkVNkpwQOcI1rgqjfxcqxIlGkw4En50bmXHQsOvp2rDELq_eUBL9mDOkjw2-uDBj9Z7Pd0Ky_lS8lvhLyjwb6ofKseYOyVloeWtj70EvDypRhE9AHuhkFXM9D0pbOav8a5QfxTvyD0dYYlv2ky5JfN_74hmj90SSmx1yv7XkMDI28Xffh1yaNORsqKISi2a1T3YFU5HNi0mDyRzAbgTldLZE0WQgG1kq0ZCoMqdhvsMUqz5AHs00l5B_d06ipnIteAmhluriB-YUHJMu8U_p9V1fCoA6a5Zw%3D%3D)** Your support means the world to me. We can’t do this without you. Sincerely,

Fellow American, This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also a GOP candidate in the MUST WIN race in NC-10, a district that Congressman McHenrys just retired from and one that WILL decide who controls Washington.**

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Rick Scott is attacking the American Dream
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
this is why I'm running for Senate

| | |
---
Friend, as an immigrant, I am fiercely proud to be an American. This country has given my family and me so much: An incredible education, financial stability, opportunities to help my community, a chance to serve, and a safe place to call home.
We worked hard to win the American Dream that we're living today. For my mom, that meant double shifts followed by night classes to learn English. For me, it meant working a minimum wage job in the early mornings before homeroom to make sure that my mom could pay rent that month.
Our journey wasn't easy. But there were opportunities along the way that made my story possible. **These opportunities are the foundation of everything that our country stands for._But today, those same opportunities are under attack from far-right Republicans like my opponent Rick Scott. _**
Rick Scott and MAGA extremists like him want to end the Affordable Care Act, cut Social Security and Medicare, let Big Pharma jack up the cost of our prescription medications, keep college out of reach for so many of us, and raise taxes on working families. They're doing nothing to address any of the very real and urgent issues facing families.

body:
| | Hey Peter,

Anna here, back with another critical update from Team Williams.

We’re wrapping up 2023 this week, but we’re also setting our sights on a MAJOR fundraising goal: **Raising $100,000 ahead of our FEC end-of-year deadline on December 31. Yeah, you read that right, we need to raise $100,000 by the end of the year to ensure we’re in the best possible position going into the election year.**
